translations.idiomatic: At dawn on dingmao the Qing host tore through the barriers, killed Gui, Zushou, and more than thirty officers down to the rank of vice-commander, seized Hei Yunlong and Ma Dengyun, took six thousand horses, and divided them among the army.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，遣達海賚書與明議和。

translations.literal: Wuchen day: Dahai was sent with letters to negotiate peace with the Ming.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Dahai was dispatched with letters to treat for peace.

sentences.zh: 壬申，貝勒阿巴泰、濟爾哈朗略通州，焚其舟，攻張家灣，克之。

translations.literal: Renshen day: beile Abatai and Jirhalang raided Tongzhou, burned its boats, attacked Zhangjiawan, and took it.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Abatai and Jirhalang ravaged Tongzhou, burned the shipping, stormed Zhangjiawan, and captured it.

sentences.zh: 達海賚議和書二分置安定、德勝門外。

translations.literal: Dahai placed two copies of the peace letters outside Anding and Desheng gates.
translations.idiomatic: Dahai set two copies of the peace overture outside Anding and Desheng gates.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，復遣人賚書赴安定門。

translations.literal: Yihai day: envoys were again sent with letters to Anding Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day another embassy was sent to Anding Gate.

sentences.zh: 俱不報。

translations.literal: There was no reply in either case.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming made no answer.

sentences.zh: 丙子，駐師通州。

translations.literal: Bingzi day: the army encamped at Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day the host halted at Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，岳託、薩哈廉、豪格率兵四千圍永平。

translations.literal: Dingchou day: Yuetuo, Sahalian, and Hooge led four thousand men to besiege Yongping.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Yuetuo, Sahalian, and Hooge invested Yongping with four thousand men.

sentences.zh: 遂克香河、馬蘭峪諸城，復叛去。

translations.literal: They then took Xianghe, Malanyu, and other towns, which again rebelled and were lost.
translations.idiomatic: They took Xianghe, Malanyu, and other places, which then rose again and slipped from their grasp.

sentences.zh: 己卯，大軍趣永平。

translations.literal: Jimao day: the main army pressed toward Yongping.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day the main force marched on Yongping.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月辛巳朔，大軍至榛子鎮、沙河驛，俱降。

translations.literal: Fourth year, spring, first month, first day (xinsi cyclical): the main army reached Zhenzizhen and Shahe Post; both surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the fourth year, on the first day of the month, the host reached Zhenzizhen and Shahe Post, and both submitted.

sentences.zh: 壬午，至永平。

translations.literal: Renwu day: reached Yongping.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day it arrived at Yongping.

sentences.zh: 先是，劉興祚自我國逃歸，匿崇煥所。

translations.literal: Earlier Liu Xingzuo had fled from our state and was hidden with Chonghuan.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xingzuo had earlier defected from the Qing side and was sheltered by Chonghuan.

sentences.zh: 至是，率所手巂滿洲兵十五人、蒙古兵五百欲往守沙河。

translations.literal: At this time he led fifteen Manchu troops in his personal service and five hundred Mongols intending to hold Shahe.
translations.idiomatic: Now he led fifteen household Manchu soldiers and five hundred Mongols to garrison Shahe.

sentences.zh: 聞大兵至，改趣永平之太平寨，襲殺喀喇沁兵於途。

translations.literal: Hearing the main army had come, he turned toward Taiping Stockade at Yongping and on the way ambushed and killed Kharachin troops.
translations.idiomatic: Learning that the main army was near, he turned for Taiping Stockade at Yongping and cut up a Kharachin detachment on the road.

sentences.zh: 上怒其負恩，遣貝勒阿巴泰等禽斬之，裂其屍以徇。

translations.literal: The Emperor, angered at his ingratitude, sent beile Abatai and others to seize and behead him and quarter his corpse as a warning.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor, enraged at his treachery, sent Abatai and others to take him, behead him, and dismember the body for display.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，上授諸將方略，乘夜攻城。

translations.literal: Guichou day: the Emperor gave the generals their plan and stormed the city by night.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day he set the plan before his commanders and assaulted by night.

sentences.zh: 城中火藥自發，敵軍大亂，黎明克之。

translations.literal: Gunpowder in the city exploded of itself; the enemy army fell into great disorder, and at dawn the city was taken.
translations.idiomatic: Powder stores in the town blew up, the garrison collapsed in confusion, and by dawn Yongping had fallen.

sentences.zh: 貝勒濟爾哈朗等入城安撫。

translations.literal: Beile Jirhalang and others entered the city to pacify it.
translations.idiomatic: Jirhalang and the other princes entered to restore order.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，上率諸將入城，官民夾道呼萬歲。

translations.literal: Bingxu day: the Emperor led the generals into the city; officials and people lined the roads crying "Long live!"
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day he led his commanders into the city while officials and commoners thronged the streets shouting homage.

sentences.zh: 貝勒濟爾哈朗、薩哈廉守永平。

translations.literal: Beile Jirhalang and Sahalian garrisoned Yongping.
translations.idiomatic: Jirhalang and Sahalian were left to hold Yongping.

sentences.zh: 以降官白養粹為永平巡撫，孟喬芳、楊文魁為副將，縱鄉民還其家。

translations.literal: The surrendered official Bai Yangcui was made Yongping commissioner; Meng Qiaofang and Yang Wenkui were made vice-commanders; country people were sent back to their homes.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Yangcui, a Ming defector, was made commissioner of Yongping; Meng Qiaofang and Yang Wenkui vice-commanders; villagers were allowed to return home.

sentences.zh: 是日，上率大軍趣山海關。

translations.literal: That day the Emperor led the main army toward Shanhaiguan.
translations.idiomatic: The same day he marched the main host toward Shanhaiguan.

sentences.zh: 敖漢、奈曼、巴林、札魯特諸部兵攻昌黎，不克。

translations.literal: Troops of the Khorchin, Naiman, Bairin, and Jarud came to attack Changli but did not take it.
translations.idiomatic: Levies from the Khorchin, Naiman, Bairin, and Jarud assaulted Changli without success.

sentences.zh: 台頭營、鞍山堡、遷安、灤州以次降。

translations.literal: Taitouying, Anshan Fort, Qian'an, and Luanzhou surrendered in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Taitouying, Anshan Fort, Qian'an, and Luanzhou submitted one after another.

sentences.zh: 建昌參將馬光遠來歸。

translations.literal: Jianchang regional commander Ma Guangyuan came over to our side.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Guangyuan, regional commander of Jianchang, defected.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，明兵攻遵化，貝勒杜度擊敗之。

translations.literal: Dingyou day: Ming troops attacked Zunhua; beile Dudu defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day the Ming struck at Zunhua; Dudu repulsed them.

sentences.zh: 明兵入三屯營，先所下漢兒莊、喜峰口、潘家口、洪家口復叛。

translations.literal: Ming troops entered Santunying; Han'erzhuang, Xifengkou, Panjiakou, and Hongjiakou, taken earlier, rebelled again.
translations.idiomatic: Ming forces reoccupied Santunying, and Han'erzhuang, Xifengkou, Panjiakou, and Hongjiakou, once reduced, rose again.

sentences.zh: 庚子，達海等復漢兒莊，貝勒阿巴泰守之。

translations.literal: Gengzi day: Dahai and others recovered Han'erzhuang; beile Abatai garrisoned it.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Dahai retook Han'erzhuang, which Abatai was left to hold.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，喀喇沁布爾噶都為明兵所圍，遣軍往救，未至，布爾噶都自擊敗之。

translations.literal: Xinchou day: Burgudu of the Kharachin was surrounded by Ming troops; troops were sent to relieve him, but before they arrived Burgudu had already struck and defeated the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Burgudu of the Kharachin was besieged by the Ming; a relief column was dispatched, but Burgudu had already broken the siege before it came up.

sentences.zh: 其帥明兵部尚書劉之綸領兵至，樹柵。

translations.literal: Their commander, Ming Minister of War Liu Zhilun, led troops up and built palisades.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming war minister Liu Zhilun advanced with an army and threw up barriers.

sentences.zh: 我軍砲毀其柵。

translations.literal: Our artillery destroyed the palisades.
translations.idiomatic: Qing guns smashed the works.

sentences.zh: 之綸屯山中。

translations.literal: Zhilun encamped in the hills.
translations.idiomatic: Zhilun drew off into the mountains.

sentences.zh: 大貝勒代善圍之，勸之綸降，不從。

translations.literal: Great beile Daishan surrounded him and urged Zhilun to surrender; he would not.
translations.idiomatic: Daishan invested him and called on him to yield; he refused.

sentences.zh: 破其營，之綸被箭死。

translations.literal: His camp was broken; Zhilun died of an arrow wound.
translations.idiomatic: The camp was overrun and Zhilun fell to an arrow.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，移師馬蘭峪，毀其近城屯堡。

translations.literal: Renyin day: the army shifted to Malanyu and destroyed nearby walled posts.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day the host moved to Malanyu and razed neighboring forts.

sentences.zh: 丙午，喀喇沁蘇布地上書明帝，論和好之利，且勸以愛養邊民、優恤屬國之道。

translations.literal: Bingwu day: Supudi of the Kharachin memorialized the Ming emperor on the benefits of peace and urged him to cherish border people and treat subject states with kindness.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Supudi of the Kharachin wrote the Ming throne on the advantages of peace and urged the emperor to cherish frontier subjects and treat vassals generously.

sentences.zh: 不報。

translations.literal: There was no reply.
translations.idiomatic: No answer came.

sentences.zh: 樂亭復叛。

translations.literal: Laoting rebelled again.
translations.idiomatic: Laoting rose once more.

sentences.zh: 二月辛亥朔，諭貝勒諸臣，凡將士驍勇立功者，勿與攻城之役。

translations.literal: First day of the second month (xinhai cyclical): beile and ministers were instructed that any soldier who had shown valor in battle was not to be assigned to storming cities.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the second month he told the princes and officials that men who had already distinguished themselves in the field were not to be wasted on sieges.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，宴明降將麻登雲等於御幄，謂之曰：「明主視爾等將士之命如草芥，驅之死地。

translations.literal: Jiayin day: the surrendered Ming commander Ma Dengyun and others were feasted in the imperial tent; he said to them: "The Ming ruler treats your officers and soldiers' lives like grass and drives you to your deaths.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day he feasted the Ming defector Ma Dengyun and others in the imperial tent and said, “Your sovereign treats soldiers' lives like weeds and sends you to die.”

sentences.zh: 朕屢遣使議和，竟無一言相報，何也？

translations.literal: I have repeatedly sent envoys to negotiate peace, yet not a word comes back—why?
translations.idiomatic: “Again and again I have sent to treat for peace, and you give no answer—why?”

sentences.zh: 」登雲對曰：「明帝幼沖，大臣各圖自保，議和之事，儻不見聽，罪且不測，故懼不敢奏。

translations.literal: Dengyun replied: "The Ming emperor is in his minority; the great ministers each scheme for their own safety. On the matter of peace, if the proposal were not accepted, punishment could not be foreseen—so in fear they dare not memorialize."
translations.idiomatic: Dengyun answered: "The Ming emperor is still a boy on the throne. Every senior minister is busy saving his own skin. If they urged peace and the court refused, who knows what punishment would follow? They are afraid to bring it up at all."

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「若然，是天讚我也，豈可棄之而歸。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "If that is so, Heaven is aiding me—how could I abandon this and turn home?"
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "If that is truly the case, Heaven itself is on my side. How could I walk away now?"

sentences.zh: 但駐兵屯守，妨農時為可憫耳。

translations.literal: Only that troops garrisoned and encamped will hinder the farming season—that is what deserves pity."
translations.idiomatic: "Only pity the farmers whose season our encampments will disrupt."

sentences.zh: 且彼山海關、錦州防守尚堅，今但取其無備城邑可也。

translations.literal: Moreover, Shanhaiguan and Jinzhou are still stoutly defended; for now we need only take towns that lie unwary."
translations.idiomatic: "Shanhaiguan and Jinzhou are still too strong to rush. For the moment, let us take only those towns that do not expect us."

sentences.zh: 」己未，遺書明帝，仍申和好，並致書明諸臣，勸其急定和議，至是凡七致書矣。

translations.literal: On the jiwei day he sent a letter to the Ming emperor again proposing peace, and letters to Ming ministers urging them to settle the peace talks quickly—by now he had written seven times in all.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day he wrote again to the Ming emperor pleading for peace, and to Ming officials urging them to conclude a treaty without delay. This made the seventh such letter.

sentences.zh: 甲子，明榆林副將王世選來降。

translations.literal: On the jiazi day Wang Shixuan, Ming deputy commander of Yulin, came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day Wang Shixuan, deputy commander at Yulin in Ming service, defected.

sentences.zh: 上班師，貝勒阿巴泰、濟爾哈朗、薩哈廉及文臣索尼、寧完我等守永平，鮑承先守遷安，固山額真圖爾格、那木泰等守灤州，察喀喇、范文程等守遵化。

translations.literal: The Emperor withdrew the army. Beile Abatai, Jirhalang, and Sahalian, with the civil officials Sony and Ning Wanwo, held Yongping; Bao Chengxian held Qian'an; gushan ejen Turgai, Namutai, and others held Luanzhou; Chakara, Fan Wencheng, and others held Zunhua.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor led the main force home. Beile Abatai, Jirhalang, and Sahalian, with the civil officials Sony and Ning Wanwo, garrisoned Yongping; Bao Chengxian held Qian'an; gushan ejen Turgai and Namutai held Luanzhou; Chakara and Fan Wencheng held Zunhua.

sentences.zh: 駐灤三日，論功行賞。

translations.literal: He halted at Luanzhou for three days and distributed rewards according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: He remained at Luanzhou three days to review merit and grant rewards.

sentences.zh: 壬申，諭曰：「天以明土地人民予我，其民即吾民，宜飭軍士勿加侵害，違者治罪。

translations.literal: On the renshen day an edict declared: "Heaven has given me the Ming land and people; their people are my people. Soldiers are to be ordered not to harm them; violators will be punished."
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day he proclaimed: "Heaven has delivered the Ming lands and people into my hands. They are my people now. Command the troops to do them no injury—whoever disobeys will answer for it."

sentences.zh: 」上至永平，降官郎中陳此心謀遁，事覺論斬，上赦之，聽其所往。

translations.literal: When the Emperor reached Yongping, the surrendered official Chen Cixin, a director in the Ministry of Revenue, plotted to flee. The plot was discovered and he was sentenced to death; the Emperor pardoned him and let him go where he wished.
translations.idiomatic: At Yongping the surrendered revenue official Chen Cixin tried to escape. When the plot came to light he was condemned to death, but the Emperor spared him and allowed him to depart freely.

sentences.zh: 三月壬午，上還瀋陽。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the renshen day of the sexagenary cycle, the Emperor returned to Shenyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the renshen day, the Emperor came back to Shenyang.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，遣二貝勒阿敏、貝勒碩託率兵五千往守永平四城，貝勒阿巴泰等還。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day the second beile Amin and beile Shuo Tuo were sent with five thousand men to hold the four Yongping cities; beile Abatai and the others were recalled.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day Second Beile Amin and Beile Shuo Tuo marched out with five thousand men to garrison the four Yongping towns, while Beile Abatai and his colleagues withdrew.

sentences.zh: 庚子，阿魯四子部遣使來盟。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day the Aru Four Sons tribe sent envoys to conclude an alliance.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day the Aru Four Sons tribe sent envoys to swear alliance.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬子，明兵攻灤州，不克。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the renzi day, Ming troops attacked Luanzhou but could not take it.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the renzi day, Ming forces assaulted Luanzhou without success.

sentences.zh: 己卯，貝勒阿巴泰、濟爾哈朗等自永平還。

translations.literal: On the jimao day beile Abatai, Jirhalang, and the rest returned from Yongping.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day Beile Abatai, Jirhalang, and the others returned from Yongping.

sentences.zh: 上問是役俘獲較前孰多，對曰：「此行所獲人口甚多。

translations.literal: The Emperor asked whether captives from this campaign were greater than in the previous one. The reply was: "On this expedition the population taken was very great."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor asked whether this campaign had yielded more captives than the last. They answered, "This time we took a great multitude of people."

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「財帛不足喜，惟多得人為可喜耳。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Goods and silks are not worth rejoicing over; only to gain many people is truly worth joy."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Gold and cloth are nothing to celebrate. What pleases me is winning people."

sentences.zh: 五月己丑，諭諸臣厚撫俘眾。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the jichou day, he ordered the ministers to treat captives generously.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the jichou day, he commanded his ministers to care for the captives with generosity.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，阿敏、碩託等棄永平四城歸。

translations.literal: On the renchen day Amin, Shuo Tuo, and the others abandoned the four Yongping cities and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day Amin and Shuo Tuo abandoned the four Yongping garrisons and marched home.

sentences.zh: 時明監軍道張春、錦州總兵祖大壽等合兵攻灤州。

translations.literal: At that time Zhang Chun, Ming supervising secretary on campaign, and Zu Dashou, commander at Jinzhou, joined forces to attack Luanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: By then Zhang Chun, the Ming campaign supervisor, and Zu Dashou, commander at Jinzhou, had united their armies against Luanzhou.

sentences.zh: 那穆泰、圖爾格、湯古代等出戰，屢敗明兵，然兵少，阿敏、碩託畏不往援，明兵用砲攻灤州，那穆泰等不能支，棄城奔永平。

translations.literal: Namutai, Turgai, Tangundai, and others went out to fight and repeatedly defeated Ming troops, but their force was small; Amin and Shuo Tuo, fearing, did not go to their aid. Ming troops bombarded Luanzhou with cannon; Namutai and the rest could not hold and abandoned the city, fleeing to Yongping.
translations.idiomatic: Namutai, Turgai, and Tangundai sallied forth and beat the Ming again and again, but they were too few. Amin and Shuo Tuo, afraid to reinforce them, held back while Ming artillery battered Luanzhou. Namutai's garrison could not stand; they abandoned the city and fled toward Yongping.

sentences.zh: 會天雨，我軍潰圍出，無馬被創者死四百餘人。

translations.literal: Rain fell; our army broke out of the encirclement. More than four hundred men without horses, wounded, died.
translations.idiomatic: Rain came down as our men broke through the siege. Over four hundred wounded foot soldiers who had lost their mounts perished.

sentences.zh: 阿敏、碩託聞之恐，遂殺降官白養粹等，盡屠城中士民，收其金幣，乘夜出冷口。

translations.literal: When Amin and Shuo Tuo heard this they were terrified. They killed the surrendered officials Bai Yangcui and others, slaughtered every soldier and civilian in the city, seized their gold and coin, and slipped out by night through Lengkou Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Amin and Shuo Tuo, hearing of the disaster, were seized with panic. They put the surrendered official Bai Yangcui and his fellows to the sword, massacred the soldiers and townspeople, looted their gold, and stole away by night through Cold Pass.

sentences.zh: 察哈喇等亦棄遵化歸。

translations.literal: Chakara and the others also abandoned Zunhua and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Chakara too abandoned Zunhua and fell back.

sentences.zh: 上方命貝勒杜度趨永平協守，且敕阿敏善撫官民，無侵暴，將整兵親往。

translations.literal: The Emperor had just ordered beile Dudu to hurry to Yongping to help hold it, and had instructed Amin to treat officials and people kindly without violence, intending to lead the army in person.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor had already ordered Beile Dudu to march to Yongping to reinforce the defense, and had warned Amin to treat officials and civilians gently and forbid pillage, while he himself prepared to take the field.

sentences.zh: 庚子，聞阿敏棄城，且大肆屠戮，乃止。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day, learning that Amin had abandoned the cities and carried out a great slaughter, he halted.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, when word came that Amin had deserted the towns and butchered the populace, he called the expedition off.

sentences.zh: 六月甲寅，收繫棄城諸將，數其罪。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the jiayin day, the generals who had abandoned the cities were arrested and their crimes enumerated.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jiayin day, the commanders who had deserted their posts were seized and charged one by one.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，御殿宣阿敏十六罪。

translations.literal: On the yimao day he took the throne hall and proclaimed sixteen crimes of Amin.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day he sat in open court and read out sixteen counts against Amin.

sentences.zh: 眾議當誅。

translations.literal: The assembly judged that he should be put to death.
translations.idiomatic: The council unanimously demanded his execution.

sentences.zh: 上不忍致法，幽之。

translations.literal: The Emperor could not bear to apply the law and had him imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor could not bring himself to carry out the sentence and had Amin confined instead.

sentences.zh: 碩託、湯古代、那穆泰、巴布泰、圖爾格等各奪爵、革職有差。

translations.literal: Shuo Tuo, Tangundai, Namutai, Babutai, Turgai, and the rest were each stripped of rank and office in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Shuo Tuo, Tangundai, Namutai, Babutai, Turgai, and the others were degraded in rank and dismissed from office to different degrees.

sentences.zh: 諸將中有力戰殺敵者釋之。

translations.literal: Among the generals, those who had fought hard and killed the enemy were released.
translations.idiomatic: Officers who had fought fiercely and slain the enemy in battle were spared punishment.

sentences.zh: 先是阿敏既屠永平官民，以其妻子分給士卒。

translations.literal: Earlier, after Amin had slaughtered the officials and people of Yongping, he distributed their wives and children among the soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: After Amin's massacre at Yongping he had parceled out the victims' wives and children as slaves to his troops.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「彼既屠我歸順良民，又奴其妻子耶！

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "He has already slaughtered people who surrendered to us in good faith—shall we now make slaves of their wives and children as well?"
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "He butchered people who had come over to us in good faith—and now we are to enslave their families?"

sentences.zh: 」命編為民戶，以房舍衣食給之。

translations.literal: He ordered them registered as civilian households and provided with houses, clothing, and food.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the survivors enrolled as civilian households and given shelter, clothing, and provisions.

sentences.zh: 秋九月戊戌，申諭諸大臣滿、漢官各勤職業。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of autumn, on the xuany day, he again admonished the great ministers, Manchu and Han officials alike, each to attend diligently to his duties.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of autumn, on the xuany day, he again exhorted his great ministers and every Manchu and Han official to perform his office with diligence.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛酉，諭編審各旗壯丁，隱匿者罰之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the xinyou day, he ordered a review and registration of able-bodied men in each banner; those who concealed men would be punished.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the xinyou day, he ordered each banner to muster and register its able-bodied men, with penalties for anyone who hid conscripts.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲午，那堪泰部虎爾噶率家屬來歸，阿魯四子部諸貝勒來歸。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the jiawu day, Huerga of the Nakan Tai tribe came over with his household, and the beile of the Aru Four Sons tribe submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the jiawu day, Huerga of the Nakan Tai tribe arrived with his family, and the beile of the Aru Four Sons tribe came in.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，阿魯伊蘇忒部聞上善養民，留所部於西拉木輪河，而偕我使臣察漢喇嘛來朝。

translations.literal: On the renyin day the Aru Isut tribe, hearing that the Emperor treated his people well, left their main body on the Xilamulun River and came to court with our envoy Chahan Lama.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day the Aru Isut tribe, hearing that the Emperor nourished his subjects well, left their main camp on the Xilamulun River and accompanied our envoy Chahan Lama to court.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊辰，科爾沁貝勒圖美衛徵來朝。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the wuchen day, Tumai Weizheng, beile of the Khorchin, came to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the wuchen day, Khorchin Beile Tumai Weizheng presented himself at court.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月庚辰，諭已故功臣無後者，家產給其妻自贍。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, spring, first month, on the gengchen day, an edict declared that where deceased meritorious officials left no heirs, their estates should be given to their wives for their maintenance.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, in the first month of spring, on the gengchen day, he decreed that when a meritorious official died without heirs, his property should pass to his widow for her support.

sentences.zh: 壬午，鑄紅衣大砲成，金雋曰「天祐助威大將軍」。

translations.literal: On the renwu day the casting of great red-coated cannon was completed; they were inscribed "Great General, Heaven's Aid and Might."
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day the great red-barrel cannon were cast and named "Great General of Heaven's Aid and Triumphant Might."

sentences.zh: 軍中造砲自此始。

translations.literal: From this time the army began to manufacture cannon.
translations.idiomatic: Field artillery manufacture in the army began from this date.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以額駙佟養性總理漢人軍民事，漢官聽其節制。

translations.literal: On the yiwei day the imperial son-in-law Tong Yangxing was put in overall charge of Han military and civil affairs; Han officials were placed under his command.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day Imperial Son-in-law Tong Yangxing was appointed to supervise all Han military and civil affairs, with Han officials subject to his orders.

sentences.zh: 己亥，幸文館，入庫爾纏直房，問所修何書。

translations.literal: On the jihai day the Emperor visited the Literary Institute, entered Kurchen's office, and asked what book was being compiled.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day the Emperor visited the Literary Institute, stepped into Kurchen's study, and asked what work was in progress.

sentences.zh: 對曰：「記註所行政事。

translations.literal: The reply was: "A chronicle of administrative acts."
translations.idiomatic: They answered, "A day-by-day record of government business."

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「如此，朕不宜觀。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "If that is so, it is not fitting for me to read it."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "In that case I had better not look at it."

sentences.zh: 」又覽達海所譯武銓，見投醪飲河事，曰：「古良將體恤士卒，三軍之士樂為致死。

translations.literal: He also looked through Dahai's translation of the Wujing and, seeing the story of casting wine into the river for the troops to drink, said: "Ancient good generals cherished their soldiers; the men of the three armies were glad to die for them."
translations.idiomatic: He also browsed Dahai's translation of the military classics and, coming upon the tale of a general who poured his wine into the river so his men could drink, remarked, "The great captains of old shared their soldiers' hardships. Men would die gladly for such leaders."

sentences.zh: 若額駙顧三台對敵時，見戰士歿者，以繩曳之歸，安能得人死力乎！

translations.literal: If the imperial son-in-law Gu Santai, facing the enemy, had his men drag back the dead with ropes when they fell, how could he have won their utmost strength?"
translations.idiomatic: "But if Imperial Son-in-law Gu Santai, in the face of battle, had corpses hauled away on ropes while the living watched, how could he ever have earned their wholehearted loyalty?"

sentences.zh: 」庚子，朝鮮貢物不及額，卻之，以書責其罪。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day Korea's tribute fell short of the quota; he refused it and sent a letter reproaching their fault.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day Korea's tribute came in below the required amount. He rejected it and dispatched a letter denouncing the breach.

sentences.zh: 二月庚申，敕邊臣謹斥堠。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the gengshen day, he ordered frontier officials to maintain watch-posts vigilantly.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the gengshen day, he commanded border officers to keep their outposts in strict readiness.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，孟阿圖征瓦爾喀，奏捷。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day Meng Atu campaigned against the Warka and reported victory.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day Meng Atu marched against the Warka and sent word of victory.

sentences.zh: 三月乙亥朔，鑲藍旗固山額真、額駙顧三台罷，以太祖弟之子篇古代之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the third month, the bordered blue banner gushan ejen and imperial son-in-law Gu Santai were dismissed; Piangu, a son of the Taizu's younger brother, replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the third month the bordered blue banner gushan ejen and imperial son-in-law Gu Santai were removed from office and replaced by Piangu, son of the Taizu's younger brother.

sentences.zh: 書諭大貝勒代善、三貝勒莽古爾泰及貝勒諸大臣，求直言過失。

translations.literal: He wrote to Grand Beile Daishan, Third Beile Manggotai, and the beile and great ministers, asking them to speak frankly of his faults.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote to Grand Beile Daishan, Third Beile Manggotai, and the other beile and ministers, inviting blunt criticism of his own failings.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，閱漢兵。

translations.literal: On the dinghai day he reviewed the Han troops.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day he inspected the Han forces.

sentences.zh: 甲午，誅劉興祚、興治家屬，赦其母。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day the families of Liu Xingzuo and Liu Xingzhi were executed; their mother was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day the households of Liu Xingzuo and Liu Xingzhi were put to death, though their mother was spared.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，朝鮮復遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On the dingyou day Korea again sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day Korea once more sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，遣滿達爾漢、董訥密遺朝鮮王書，索戰船助攻明。

translations.literal: On the xinchou day Mandahan and Dongnami were dispatched with a secret letter to the king of Korea demanding warships to join the attack on the Ming.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day Mandahan and Dongnami were sent with a confidential letter to the king of Korea demanding war junks for an assault on the Ming.

sentences.zh: 不許。

translations.literal: Permission was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was refused.

sentences.zh: 六月癸亥，定功臣襲職例。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the guihai day, regulations for hereditary succession by meritorious officials were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the guihai day, rules were fixed for hereditary office among the families of meritorious officials.

sentences.zh: 黑龍江伊札訥、薩克提、伽期訥、俄力喀、康柱等五頭目來朝。

translations.literal: Five chiefs of the Heilongjiang—Yizhanu, Saketi, Jiaqinu, Olikha, and Kangzhu—came to court.
translations.idiomatic: Five chiefs of the Heilongjiang—Yizhanu, Saketi, Jiaqinu, Olikha, and Kangzhu—presented themselves at court.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲戌，黑龍江虎爾哈部四頭目來朝貢。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the jiaxu day, four chiefs of the Heilongjiang Hurka tribe came to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the jiaxu day, four chiefs of the Heilongjiang Hurka came in with tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，始設六部，以墨勒根戴青貝勒多爾袞，貝勒德格類、薩哈廉、岳託、濟爾哈朗、阿巴泰等管六部事。

translations.literal: On the gengchen day the Six Ministries were established for the first time. Beile Dorgon, titled Mergen Daiqing, and beile Degui, Sahalian, Yueto, Jirhalang, and Abatai were placed in charge of the six ministries.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day the Six Ministries were founded. Beile Dorgon, titled Mergen Daiqing, together with Beile Degui, Sahalian, Yueto, Jirhalang, and Abatai were assigned to head them.

sentences.zh: 每部滿、漢、蒙古分設承政官，其下設參政各八員，啟心郎各一員，改巴克什為筆帖式，其尚稱巴克什者仍其舊。

translations.literal: In each ministry Manchu, Han, and Mongol supervising officials were appointed separately; beneath them eight assistant administrators in each office, one qixinlang in each, and the title bakshi was changed to bitheci—those still called bakshi kept the old title.
translations.idiomatic: Each ministry received separate supervising officers for Manchu, Han, and Mongol affairs, with eight assistant administrators below them and one qixinlang apiece. The title bakshi was renamed bitheci, though men who still bore the old title kept it.

sentences.zh: 更定訐告諸貝勒者准其離主例，其以細事訐訴者禁之。

translations.literal: The regulation allowing accusers of beile to leave their lords was reaffirmed; petty accusations were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: The rule permitting subjects who accused a beile to leave his service was confirmed, while trivial lawsuits were banned.

sentences.zh: 諭貝勒審事冤抑不公者坐罪。

translations.literal: Beile who judged cases with injustice or partiality would be punished.
translations.idiomatic: Beile who heard cases unfairly would themselves be punished.

sentences.zh: 除職官有罪概行削職律，嗣後有罪者，分別輕重降罰有差。

translations.literal: The law stripping all guilty officials of office without distinction was abolished; thereafter the guilty would be demoted and penalized according to the gravity of the offense.
translations.idiomatic: The blanket rule that any guilty official lost his post outright was repealed; from now on punishment would vary with the seriousness of the crime.

sentences.zh: 並禁官民同族嫁娶，犯者男婦以奸論。

translations.literal: Marriage within the same clan among officials and commoners was also forbidden; violators, man and woman alike, were treated as guilty of adultery.
translations.idiomatic: He also forbade marriage within the same clan among officials and commoners, treating offenders of either sex as adulterers.

sentences.zh: 又諭貝勒諸大臣省過改行，求極諫。

translations.literal: He further admonished the beile and great ministers to examine their conduct, reform their ways, and welcome the sternest remonstrance.
translations.idiomatic: He again urged the beile and great ministers to examine their conduct, mend their ways, and welcome the harshest counsel.

sentences.zh: 甲申，鬧雷虎爾哈部四頭目來朝貢。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day four chiefs of the Naolei Hurka tribe came to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day four chiefs of the Naolei Hurka presented tribute at court.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，定小事賞罰例，令牛錄額真審理，大者送部。

translations.literal: On the guisi day regulations for rewards and punishments in minor matters were fixed: niru ejen were to judge them, major cases were to be sent to the ministries.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day rules for petty rewards and penalties were set: niru ejen would decide small cases, while grave ones went to the ministries.

sentences.zh: 明總兵祖大壽等築大凌河。

translations.literal: Ming regional commander Zu Dashou and others fortified Dalinghe.
translations.idiomatic: Zu Dashou, the Ming regional commander, and others began fortifying Dalinghe.

sentences.zh: 檄諸蒙古各率所部來會征之。

translations.literal: Orders were sent to the Mongol tribes each to bring their contingents to join the expedition against it.
translations.idiomatic: He issued orders for each Mongol tribe to march its forces to the siege.

sentences.zh: 己亥，大軍西發，命貝勒杜度、薩哈廉、豪格留守。

translations.literal: On the jihai day the great army marched west. Beile Dudu, Sahalian, and Hooge were left to hold the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day the main host marched west, leaving Beile Dudu, Sahalian, and Hooge to guard the homeland.

sentences.zh: 庚子，渡遼河，申誡諸將恤士卒。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day they crossed the Liao River, and the Emperor again warned the generals to cherish their soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day they crossed the Liao, and the Emperor once more charged his commanders to care for their men.

sentences.zh: 八月壬寅朔，次舊遼河而營，蒙古諸部率兵來會。

translations.literal: On the first day of the eighth month the army encamped on the old Liao River; Mongol tribes arrived with their troops to join.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eighth month the army halted on the old Liao River as Mongol contingents came in to the rendezvous.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，集蒙古諸貝勒，申前令，無擅殺掠。

translations.literal: On the guimao day the Mongol beile were assembled and the earlier order repeated: no unauthorized killing or plunder.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day he gathered the Mongol beile and repeated his earlier command: no killing or looting without leave.

sentences.zh: 於是分兵兩路，貝勒德格類、岳託、阿濟格以兵二萬由義州入屯錦州、大凌河之間，上自白土場入廣寧。

translations.literal: Thereupon the force divided into two columns. Beile Degui, Yueto, and Ajige with twenty thousand men entered by Yizhou and encamped between Jinzhou and Dalinghe; the Emperor himself entered Guangning by Baituchang.
translations.idiomatic: The army then split. Beile Degui, Yueto, and Ajige led twenty thousand men through Yizhou to camp between Jinzhou and Dalinghe, while the Emperor marched into Guangning by way of Baituchang.

sentences.zh: 丁未，會於大凌河，乘夜攻城。

translations.literal: On the dingwei day the columns united at Dalinghe and attacked the city by night.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day the columns united at Dalinghe and assaulted the walls by night.

sentences.zh: 令曰：「攻城恐傷士卒，當掘壕築壘困之。

translations.literal: His order ran: "Storming the city may wound the troops; we should dig trenches and build ramparts to besiege them."
translations.idiomatic: His order read: "A direct assault will cost us men. Dig trenches and raise earthworks and starve them out."

sentences.zh: 彼若出，與之戰，外援至，迎擊之。

translations.literal: If they come out, give battle; if relief arrives, meet and strike it."
translations.idiomatic: "If they sally forth, fight them. If reinforcements come, intercept them."

sentences.zh: 」乃分八旗兵合圍，令蒙古兵承其隙。

translations.literal: The Eight Banner troops were deployed in a combined encirclement, with Mongol forces filling the gaps.
translations.idiomatic: The Eight Banners closed the ring around the fortress while Mongol detachments sealed the gaps.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，明馬步兵五百人出城，達爾哈擊敗之。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day five hundred Ming horse and foot soldiers came out of the city; Darha defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day five hundred Ming cavalry and infantry sallied from the city; Darha routed them.

sentences.zh: 壬子，射書城中，招蒙古人出降。

translations.literal: On the renzi day letters were shot into the city summoning the Mongols inside to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day messages were fired into the town calling on the Mongol defenders to defect.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，明兵出城誘戰。

translations.literal: On the guichou day Ming troops came out to lure our forces into battle.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day Ming troops emerged to bait our men into a fight.

sentences.zh: 圖賴先入，達爾哈繼之，四面環攻，貝勒多爾袞亦率兵入。

translations.literal: Tulai charged in first, Darha followed, and on all four sides the encirclement closed; beile Dorgon also led troops in.
translations.idiomatic: Tulai struck first, Darha came behind him, and the ring closed on every side as Beile Dorgon led more men in.

sentences.zh: 城內砲矢俱發，圖賴被創，副將孟坦、屯布祿、備御多貝、侍衛戈裡戰歿。

translations.literal: Cannon and arrows fired from within the walls; Tulai was wounded, and the deputy commanders Mengtan, Tunbulu, the guard officer Duobei, and the bodyguard Geli died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Guns and arrows blazed from the ramparts. Tulai was wounded; Deputy Commanders Mengtan and Tunbulu, Guard Officer Duobei, and the bodyguard Geli fell in the fight.

sentences.zh: 上以圖賴等輕進，切責之。

translations.literal: Because Tulai and the others had advanced rashly, the Emperor sharply rebuked them.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor rebuked Tulai and the rest sharply for their reckless charge.

sentences.zh: 以紅衣砲攻明台，兵降者相繼。

translations.literal: Red-coated cannon were used against the Ming towers, and soldiers surrendered in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Red-barrel cannon battered the Ming bastions, and defenders surrendered one after another.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，遺祖大壽書曰：「往者我欲和，爾國君臣以宋為鑒，不我應。

translations.literal: On the yimao day he sent Zu Dashou a letter saying: "In the past I sought peace, but your court's ministers, taking Song history as their warning, would not answer me."
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day he wrote to Zu Dashou: "I once sought peace, but your court, citing the fall of the Song, would not reply."

sentences.zh: 爾國非宋，我亦非金，何不達若此。

translations.literal: Your state is not the Song, and I am not the Jin—why such want of understanding?"
translations.idiomatic: "Your dynasty is not the Song, and I am no Jin conqueror—why cling to that lesson so blindly?"

sentences.zh: 朕今厭兵革，更以書往，惟將軍裁之。

translations.literal: I am weary of war now and send this letter again; let the general decide."
translations.idiomatic: "I am weary of war and write again. The decision is yours, General."

sentences.zh: 」大壽不答。

translations.literal: Dashou did not answer.
translations.idiomatic: Dashou made no reply.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，明松山兵二千來援，阿山、勞薩、土魯什擊敗之。

translations.literal: On the dingyou day two thousand Ming troops from Songshan came to the relief; Ashan, Laosa, and Tulushi defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day two thousand Ming troops marched out from Songshan; Ashan, Laosa, and Tulushi beat them back.

sentences.zh: 甲子，貝勒阿濟格、碩托遮擊明援兵。

translations.literal: On the jiazi day beile Ajige and Shuo Tuo intercepted the Ming relief force.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day Beile Ajige and Shuo Tuo ambushed the Ming relief column.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，明錦州兵六千來攻阿濟格營。

translations.literal: On the dingmao day six thousand Ming troops from Jinzhou attacked Ajige's camp.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day six thousand Jinzhou troops assailed Ajige's encampment.

sentences.zh: 會大霧，覿面不相識。

translations.literal: A great fog arose, so that face could not recognize face.
translations.idiomatic: A dense fog rolled in until men could not see one another's faces.

sentences.zh: 忽有青氣沖敵營，辟若門，我軍乘霧進，大戰，敗之，擒游擊一，盡獲其甲仗馬匹。

translations.literal: Suddenly a green vapor rushed against the enemy camp, opening as if a gate; our army advanced through the mist, fought a great battle, defeated them, captured one guerrilla officer, and took all their armor, weapons, and horses.
translations.idiomatic: Then a green light burst against the enemy lines, parting the mist like a gate. Our troops pressed forward through the fog, fought a fierce battle, routed the Ming, seized a guerrilla officer, and captured their armor, arms, and mounts to the last piece.

sentences.zh: 辛未，上詣貝勒阿濟格營，酌金卮勞諸將。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day the Emperor went to beile Ajige's camp and, raising a golden goblet, rewarded the generals.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day the Emperor rode to Beile Ajige's camp, lifted a golden goblet, and toasted his victorious commanders.

sentences.zh: 明兵突出，師夾擊，又大敗之。

translations.literal: Ming troops burst out; the army struck from both sides and defeated them again.
translations.idiomatic: Ming forces sallied forth; our troops caught them in a pincer and routed them once more.

sentences.zh: 九月丁亥，上以兵趨錦州，見塵起，上命諸軍勿行，自率擺牙喇兵二百，與貝勒多鐸緣山潛進。

translations.literal: Ninth month, dinghai day, the Emperor marched toward Jinzhou; seeing dust rise, he ordered the armies not to advance, himself leading two hundred bayara troops with beile Dorgon to steal along the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day of the ninth month the Emperor moved on Jinzhou. When he saw dust rising he halted the main body, took two hundred bayara guards, and with beile Dorgon crept forward along the hills.

sentences.zh: 明錦州兵七千突出進上前。

translations.literal: Seven thousand Ming Jinzhou troops burst out and advanced on the Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Seven thousand Jinzhou Ming troops sallied and pressed straight toward the Emperor.

sentences.zh: 上甫擐甲，從者不及二百人，渡河沖敵軍。

translations.literal: The Emperor had just donned armor; followers numbered fewer than two hundred; he crossed the river and charged the enemy army.
translations.idiomatic: He had barely time to arm; fewer than two hundred men were with him. He crossed the river and charged the enemy line.

sentences.zh: 敵不能當，潰走。

translations.literal: The enemy could not withstand it and fled in rout.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy could not stand and broke in flight.

sentences.zh: 諸軍繼至，又大敗之，斬一副將而還。

translations.literal: The armies came up in succession and defeated them again, beheaded one deputy commander, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: The main forces came up, defeated them again, beheaded a deputy commander, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 己丑，復以書招祖大壽。

translations.literal: Jichou day, again sent a letter summoning Zu Dashou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day he again wrote to summon Zu Dashou.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，上設伏山內，誘大壽出，將擒之，大壽驚遁，自是閉城不出。

translations.literal: Gengyin day, the Emperor set an ambush within the mountains to lure Dashou out and was about to seize him; Dashou fled in alarm; from then on he kept the city shut and did not come out.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day the Emperor laid an ambush in the hills to draw Dashou out and seize him; Dashou fled in alarm and thereafter kept the gates closed.

sentences.zh: 時城中穀止百石，馬死盡，煮馬肉為食，以鞍代爨。

translations.literal: At that time grain in the city amounted to only a hundred piculs; horses were all dead; they boiled horse flesh for food and used saddles in place of fuel.
translations.idiomatic: Grain in the city then came to only a hundred piculs; the horses had all died; the garrison boiled horseflesh for food and burned saddles for fuel.

sentences.zh: 乙未，明太僕寺卿監軍道張春，總兵吳襄、鍾緯等，以馬步兵四萬來援，壁小凌河。

translations.literal: Yiwei day, Ming Grand Secretary of the Court of Imperial Stud and army inspector Zhang Chun, regional commanders Wu Xiang, Zhong Wei, and others, with forty thousand horse and foot came to relieve the siege and encamped on the Xiao Ling River.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day Zhang Chun, Ming Grand Secretary of the Imperial Stud and army inspector, with regional commanders Wu Xiang, Zhong Wei, and others brought forty thousand horse and foot to the relief and encamped on the Xiao Ling River.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，明援兵趨大凌河，距城十五裡。

translations.literal: Wuxu day, Ming relief troops advanced on Dalinghe, fifteen li from the city.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day the Ming relief force marched on Dalinghe, fifteen li from the walls.

sentences.zh: 上率兩翼騎兵衝擊之，不動。

translations.literal: The Emperor led the cavalry of both wings in a charge; they did not move.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor led both wings of cavalry in a charge, but the enemy line held firm.

sentences.zh: 右翼兵猝入張春營，敵遂敗，吳襄及副將桑阿爾寨先奔。

translations.literal: Right-wing troops suddenly entered Zhang Chun's camp; the enemy was then defeated; Wu Xiang and deputy commander Sang'a'erzhai fled first.
translations.idiomatic: Right-wing troops suddenly broke into Zhang Chun's camp; the enemy collapsed, and Wu Xiang with deputy commander Sang'a'erzhai fled first.

sentences.zh: 張春等復集潰兵立營，會大風，敵乘風縱火，將及我軍，天忽雨，反風，復戰，遂大破之，生擒張春及副將三十三人。

translations.literal: Zhang Chun and others again gathered fugitive troops and pitched camp; a great wind arose; the enemy used the wind to set fires that were about to reach our army; Heaven suddenly sent rain; the wind reversed; fighting resumed; they were utterly defeated; Zhang Chun and thirty-three deputy commanders were taken alive.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Chun rallied the fugitives and pitched camp again. A gale rose and the enemy used it to fire on our lines, but rain suddenly fell and the wind turned back. We fought again and broke them completely, taking Zhang Chun and thirty-three deputy commanders alive.

sentences.zh: 春不屈，乞死，上赦不殺。

translations.literal: Chun would not submit and begged for death; the Emperor pardoned him and did not kill him.
translations.idiomatic: Chun refused to yield and begged for death; the Emperor spared him.

sentences.zh: 是役也，祖大壽仍以我為誘敵，故城中無應者。

translations.literal: In this battle Zu Dashou still regarded us as baiting the enemy, so there was none in the city who responded.
translations.idiomatic: In this fight Zu Dashou still took our moves as a ruse to lure out the relief army, so no one in the city came out to help.

sentences.zh: 是夕黑雲龍遁去。

translations.literal: That night Hei Yunlong slipped away.
translations.idiomatic: That night Hei Yunlong escaped.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁未，以書招祖大壽、何可剛、張存仁。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, dingwei day, sent letters summoning Zu Dashou, He Kegang, and Zhang Cunren.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the dingwei day, letters were sent summoning Zu Dashou, He Kegang, and Zhang Cunren.

sentences.zh: 己酉，再遺大壽書。

translations.literal: Jiyou day, again sent Dashou a letter.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day another letter was sent to Dashou.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以紅衣砲攻於子章台。

translations.literal: Renzi day, attacked Yuzizhang platform with red-coat cannon.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day red-coated cannon were turned on Yuzizhang platform.

sentences.zh: 台最固，三日台毀，守台將王景降，於是遠近百餘台俱下。

translations.literal: The platform was the strongest; in three days the platform was destroyed; Wang Jing, commander defending the platform, surrendered; thereupon more than a hundred platforms near and far all fell.
translations.idiomatic: The platform was the strongest of all; in three days it was battered down. Its commander Wang Jing surrendered, and more than a hundred platforms near and far followed.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，遣降將姜新招祖大壽。

translations.literal: Jiayin day, sent the surrendered general Jiang Xin to summon Zu Dashou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day the surrendered general Jiang Xin was sent to win over Zu Dashou.

sentences.zh: 大壽亦遣游擊韓棟來會。

translations.literal: Dashou also sent guerrilla officer Han Dong to meet.
translations.idiomatic: Dashou in turn sent guerrilla officer Han Dong to parley with us.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，議三貝勒莽古爾泰上前持刃罪，降貝勒，奪所屬五牛錄。

translations.literal: Guihai day, deliberated the crime of third-rank beile Manggi Ortai for drawing a blade before the Emperor; he was demoted from beile and stripped of the five niru under him.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day third-rank beile Manggi Ortai was judged for drawing a weapon in the Emperor's presence: he was reduced from beile and deprived of his five niru.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，祖大壽約我副將石廷柱議降。

translations.literal: Yichou day, Zu Dashou arranged with our deputy commander Shi Tingzhu to discuss surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day Zu Dashou agreed through our deputy commander Shi Tingzhu to negotiate surrender.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，大壽遣其子可法為質。

translations.literal: Bingyin day, Dashou sent his son Kefa as hostage.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day Dashou sent his son Kefa as a hostage.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，大凌河舉城降，獨副將何可剛不從。

translations.literal: Wuchen day, all Dalinghe surrendered; only deputy commander He Kegang would not follow.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day Dalinghe surrendered as a whole; only deputy commander He Kegang refused.

sentences.zh: 大壽掖可剛至軍前殺之，夜至御營，上優遇之，大壽遂獻取錦州策。

translations.literal: Dashou dragged Kegang before the army and killed him; at night he came to the imperial camp; the Emperor treated him generously; Dashou then presented a plan to take Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Dashou brought Kegang out before the army and had him killed, then came by night to the imperial camp, where the Emperor received him with favor. Dashou thereupon offered a plan for taking Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 己巳，遣兵隨大壽夜襲錦州，會大霧，失伍，還。

translations.literal: Jisi day, sent troops with Dashou for a night raid on Jinzhou; thick fog arose; units lost formation; they returned.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day troops went with Dashou on a night attack on Jinzhou, but heavy fog scattered the columns and they turned back.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚午朔，縱大壽還錦州。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, first day (gengwu cyclical), released Dashou to return to Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eleventh month Dashou was allowed to return to Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，毀大凌河城。

translations.literal: Wuyin day, demolished Dalinghe city.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day the works at Dalinghe were torn down.

sentences.zh: 己卯，班師。

translations.literal: Jimao day, the army withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day the army marched home.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，上還瀋陽。

translations.literal: Yiyou day, the Emperor returned to Shenyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day the Emperor returned to Shenyang.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，察哈爾侵阿魯西拉木輪地，貝勒薩哈廉、豪格移師征之，會察哈爾已去，乃還。

translations.literal: Bingxu day, the Chakhar invaded Aru Xilamulun territory; beile Sahaliyan and Hooge moved troops to campaign against them; the Chakhar had already gone; they then returned.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day the Chakhar raided Aru Xilamulun. Beile Sahaliyan and Hooge marched against them, found the Chakhar already gone, and came back.

sentences.zh: 閏十一月庚子朔，諭曰：「我兵之棄永平四城，皆貝勒等不學無術所致。

translations.literal: Intercalary eleventh month, first day (gengzi cyclical), edict: "Our army's abandonment of the four Yongping cities was entirely because the beile were unlearned and without skill.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the intercalary eleventh month an edict declared: "Our loss of the four Yongping cities came wholly from the beile's want of learning and skill."

sentences.zh: 頃大凌河之役，城中人相食，明人猶死守，及援盡城降，而錦州、松、杏猶不下，豈非其人讀書明理盡忠其主乎？

translations.literal: In the recent Dalinghe campaign people in the city ate one another, yet the Ming still held firm to the death; when relief was exhausted the city surrendered, yet Jinzhou, Songshan, and Xingshan still are not taken—is this not because their people read books, understand principle, and are wholly loyal to their lord?"
translations.idiomatic: "In the recent siege of Dalinghe the garrison ate one another, yet the Ming still held to the end; only when relief failed did the city yield, while Jinzhou, Songshan, and Xingshan remain untaken. Is this not because their people are schooled in books, understand right conduct, and serve their lord with full loyalty?"

sentences.zh: 自今凡子弟年十五歲以下、八歲以上，皆令讀書。

translations.literal: From now on all sons and younger brothers from fifteen years down to eight years and above are ordered to study.
translations.idiomatic: "Henceforth every son and younger brother from eight up to fifteen years of age must be put to books."

sentences.zh: 」遣庫爾纏等責朝鮮違約罪。

translations.literal: " Kuerchan and others were dispatched to reproach Korea for the crime of breaking treaty.
translations.idiomatic: Kuerchan and others were sent to charge Korea with breach of treaty.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，禁國中不得私立廟寺，喇嘛僧違律者還俗，巫覡星士並禁止之。

translations.literal: Gengxu day, forbidden throughout the realm to establish temples and shrines privately; lama monks who violated the law were returned to secular life; shamans, diviners, and star-masters were likewise forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day private temples and shrines were banned throughout the realm; lama monks who broke the law were laicized, and shamans, diviners, and star-readers were prohibited as well.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬辰，參將寧完我請設言官，定服制。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, renchen day, Staff Captain Ning Wanwo requested establishment of remonstrating officials and fixing of court dress regulations.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day of the twelfth month Staff Captain Ning Wanwo petitioned to institute censorial remonstrators and to codify court dress.

sentences.zh: 上嘉納之。

translations.literal: The Emperor commended and accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 丙申，用禮部參政李伯龍言，更定元旦朝賀行禮班次。

translations.literal: Bingshen day, adopting Remonstrance Bureau Vice Commissioner Li Bolong's words, revised the order of rites at New Year's court audience and congratulatory ceremonies.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, following Vice Commissioner Li Bolong of the Board of Rites, the order of ceremony at the New Year court audience was revised.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月癸亥，閱漢兵。

translations.literal: Sixth year, spring, first month, guihai day, reviewed Han troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the sixth year, on the guihai day, Han troops were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 二月壬申，定儀仗制。

translations.literal: Second month, renshen day, fixed regulations for ceremonial guards.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day of the second month regulations for ceremonial guards were established.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，謁太祖陵，行時享禮。

translations.literal: Dingchou day, visited Taizu's tomb and performed the seasonal offering rite.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day he visited Taizu's tomb and performed the seasonal offering.

sentences.zh: 戊子，諭海州等處城守官三年一赴瀋陽考察。

translations.literal: Wuzi day, ordered garrison officials of Haizhou and other places to come to Shenyang every three years for inspection.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day he ordered garrison commanders of Haizhou and other posts to report to Shenyang every three years for review.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，諭戶部貝勒德格類以大凌河漢人分隸副將以下，給配撫養。

translations.literal: Dingyou day, instructed Household Bureau beile Dorgide to assign Dalinghe Han Chinese to deputy commanders and below for allotment and support.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day he charged Household Bureau beile Dorgide to distribute Dalinghe Han Chinese among deputy commanders and below for allotment and maintenance.

sentences.zh: 給還貝勒莽古爾泰所罰人口。

translations.literal: Restored to beile Manggi Ortai the population that had been confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: The households taken from beile Manggi Ortai were restored to him.

sentences.zh: 三月戊戌，賚大凌河諸降將有差。

translations.literal: Third month, wuxu day, rewarded Dalinghe surrendered generals in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day of the third month the surrendered generals of Dalinghe were rewarded according to merit.

sentences.zh: 命達海分析國書音義。

translations.literal: Ordered Dahai to analyze the phonology and meaning of the national script.
translations.idiomatic: Dahai was ordered to work out the sounds and meanings of the national script.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，定訐告諸貝勒者輕重虛實坐罪例，禁子弟告父兄、妻告夫者，定貝勒大臣賜祭葬例。

translations.literal: Gengxu day, fixed statutes for accusing beile—grading lightness, heaviness, truth, and falsehood and fixing penalties; forbade sons and younger brothers to accuse fathers and elder brothers, wives to accuse husbands; fixed regulations for sacrificial and burial honors of beile and great ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day laws were set for denouncing beile, with penalties graded by the weight and truth of the charge; children were forbidden to accuse fathers and elder brothers, and wives their husbands; rules for the sacrificial and funeral honors of beile and senior ministers were also fixed.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，征察哈爾，徵蒙古兵，頒軍令。

translations.literal: Dingsi day, campaigned against the Chakhar, levied Mongol troops, promulgated army regulations.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day the Chakhar campaign was ordered, Mongol levies were called up, and army regulations were issued.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊辰朔，上率大軍西發，阿巴泰、杜度、揚古利、伊爾登、佟養性留守。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, first day (wuchen cyclical), the Emperor led the great army west; Abatai, Dudu, Yanggūri, Ilden, and Tong Yangxing remained on guard.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fourth month of summer the Emperor marched west at the head of the main host, leaving Abatai, Dudu, Yanggūri, Ilden, and Tong Yangxing to hold the rear.

sentences.zh: 己巳，次遼河。

translations.literal: Jisi day, halted at the Liao River.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day the army encamped on the Liao River.

sentences.zh: 丙子，次西拉木輪河。

translations.literal: Bingzi day, halted at the Xilamulun River.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day it halted at the Xilamulun River.

sentences.zh: 己卯，次札滾烏達，諸蒙古部兵以次來會。

translations.literal: Jimao day, halted at Zhagun Wuda; Mongol tribal troops came to join in succession.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day it halted at Zhagun Wuda, where Mongol contingents joined one after another.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，次哈納崖。

translations.literal: Yiyou day, halted at Hana Cliffs.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day it halted at Hana Cliffs.

sentences.zh: 察哈爾汗林丹聞我師至，大懼，驅歸化城富民牲畜渡河西奔，盡委輜重而去。

translations.literal: Chakhar Khan Lindan, hearing our army had come, was greatly afraid; he drove the wealthy of Guihua City and their livestock across the river westward and abandoned all baggage train and departed.
translations.idiomatic: Chakhar Khan Lindan, hearing our host was near, was stricken with fear; he drove Guihua City's rich households and their herds across the river to the west and abandoned his entire baggage train in flight.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，次都勒河，聞察哈爾林丹遠遁，上趨歸化城。

translations.literal: Gengyin day, halted at the Dule River; hearing Chakhar Lindan had fled far away, the Emperor pressed toward Guihua City.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day the army halted at the Dule River; learning that Lindan had fled far off, the Emperor hurried toward Guihua City.

sentences.zh: 丙申，大軍自阿濟格和爾戈還趨察哈爾。

translations.literal: Bingshen day, the great army turned back from Ajige He'erge and marched again toward the Chakhar.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day the main force turned back from Ajige He'erge and drove again toward the Chakhar.

sentences.zh: 五月癸卯，諭諸部貝勒大臣勿輕進，勿退縮，勿殺降，勿分散人妻子，勿奪人衣服財物。

translations.literal: Fifth month, guimao day, edict to beile and great ministers of all tribes: do not advance rashly, do not shrink back, do not kill those who surrender, do not separate men from wives and children, do not seize others' clothing or goods.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day of the fifth month he warned the beile and ministers of every tribe not to advance rashly, not to hang back, not to slaughter captives, not to separate families, and not to seize clothing or property.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，次布龍圖布喇克。

translations.literal: Jiachen day, halted at Bulongtu Bulake.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day the army encamped at Bulongtu Bulake.

sentences.zh: 丁未，勞薩奏報察哈爾遁去已久，逐北三日無所見。

translations.literal: Dingwei day, Laosa reported that the Chakhar had fled long before; pursuit north for three days found nothing.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day Laosa reported that the Chakhar had been gone for many days; three days' pursuit to the north found no trace.

sentences.zh: 上自布龍圖旋師。

translations.literal: The Emperor withdrew from Bulongtu.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor turned back from Bulongtu.

sentences.zh: 戊申，定議征明。

translations.literal: Wushen day, resolved on a campaign against the Ming.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day an expedition against the Ming was decided.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，次硃兒格土。

translations.literal: Bingchen day, halted at Zhu'ergetu.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day the army halted at Zhu'ergetu.

sentences.zh: 時糧盡，忽逢黃羊遍野，遂合圍殺數萬，脯而食之。

translations.literal: At that time grain was exhausted; suddenly yellow sheep filled the plain; a ring hunt was made and tens of thousands killed, dried, and eaten.
translations.idiomatic: Supplies were spent when yellow sheep suddenly covered the plain; the army ringed and slaughtered tens of thousands, dried the meat, and lived on it.

sentences.zh: 無水，以一羊易杯水而飲。

translations.literal: There was no water; one sheep was exchanged for a cup of water to drink.
translations.idiomatic: With no water to be had, a cup of water cost one sheep.

sentences.zh: 上命各牛錄持水迎給之。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered each niru to carry water forward and supply the army.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered every niru to bring water forward for the troops.

sentences.zh: 庚申，次木魯哈喇克沁，貝勒阿濟格率左翼略宣府、大同，貝勒濟爾哈朗率右翼略歸化城，上與大貝勒代善、貝勒莽古爾泰統大軍繼進。

translations.literal: Gengshen day, halted at Muluhalaqin; beile Ajige led the left wing to raid Xuanfu and Datong; beile Jirhalang led the right wing to raid Guihua City; the Emperor with senior beile Daishan and beile Manggi Ortai commanded the great army in follow-up.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day the host halted at Muluhalaqin. Beile Ajige led the left wing to harry Xuanfu and Datong; beile Jirhalang led the right wing against Guihua City; the Emperor with senior beile Daishan and beile Manggi Ortai followed with the main body.

sentences.zh: 甲子，上至歸化城，兩翼兵來會。

translations.literal: Jiazi day, the Emperor reached Guihua City; wing troops came to join.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day the Emperor arrived at Guihua City and the wing armies united with him.

sentences.zh: 是日，大軍馳七百里，西至黃河木訥漢山，東至宣府，自歸化城南至明邊境，所在察哈爾部民悉俘之。

translations.literal: That day the great army galloped seven hundred li—west to Munahan Mountain on the Yellow River, east to Xuanfu; from south of Guihua City to the Ming frontier, all Chakhar tribespeople in the region were taken captive.
translations.idiomatic: That day the main force swept seven hundred li—west to Munahan Mountain on the Yellow River, east to Xuanfu—and from south of Guihua City to the Ming border every Chakhar tribesman in reach was taken.

sentences.zh: 六月丁卯朔，蒙古部民竄沙河堡，上以書諭明守臣索之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, first day (dingmao cyclical), Mongol tribespeople fled into Shahe Fort; the Emperor sent a letter instructing the Ming garrison to surrender them.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the sixth month Mongol tribesmen slipped into Shahe Fort; the Emperor wrote the Ming commander demanding their return.

sentences.zh: 明歸我男婦三百二十、牲畜千四百有奇。

translations.literal: The Ming returned to us three hundred twenty men and women and somewhat more than fourteen hundred head of livestock.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming handed back three hundred twenty men and women and somewhat more than fourteen hundred head of livestock.

sentences.zh: 辛未，寧完我、范文程、馬國柱合疏言：「伐明之策，宜先以書議和，俟彼不從，執以為辭，乘釁深入，可以得志。

translations.literal: Xinwei day, Ning Wanwo, Fan Wencheng, and Ma Guozhu jointly memorialized: "The strategy for attacking the Ming should first send letters proposing peace; when they do not agree, hold that as justification; seize opportunity and strike deep—thus one may succeed."
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day Ning Wanwo, Fan Wencheng, and Ma Guozhu jointly advised: "To campaign against the Ming, open with letters offering peace; when they refuse, use that refusal as your plea and march deep on opportunity—then you may prevail."

sentences.zh: 」上嘉納之。

translations.literal: " The Emperor commended and accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor approved their counsel.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，大軍發歸化城，趨明邊。

translations.literal: Jiaxu day, the great army left Guihua City and marched on the Ming border.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day the main army left Guihua City and moved on the Ming frontier.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，明沙河堡守臣使賚牲幣來獻。

translations.literal: Dingchou day, the Ming garrison of Shahe Fort sent envoys bearing livestock and silks in tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day the Ming commander of Shahe Fort sent envoys with livestock and silks as gifts.

sentences.zh: 己卯，庫爾纏等自得勝堡，愛巴禮等由張家口，分詣大同、宣府議和。

translations.literal: Jimao day, Kuerchan and others from Desheng Fort, Aibali and others by Zhangjiakou, went separately to Datong and Xuanfu to negotiate peace.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day Kuerchan and others from Desheng Fort and Aibali and others through Zhangjiakou went separately to Datong and Xuanfu to treat for peace.

sentences.zh: 書曰：「我之興兵，非必欲取明天下也。

translations.literal: The letter read: "I have raised troops not because I must take the Ming realm.
translations.idiomatic: The letter said: "I have taken up arms not because I must conquer the Ming empire.

sentences.zh: 遼東守臣貪黷昏罔，勸葉赫陵我，遂嬰七恨。

translations.literal: Liaodong garrison officials were greedy, corrupt, and deluded; they urged the Yehe to insult us; thus I took up the Seven Grievances.
translations.idiomatic: Liaodong officials were greedy, corrupt, and blind; they incited the Yehe to slight us, and so I raised the Seven Grievances.

sentences.zh: 屢愬爾主，而遼東壅不上聞。

translations.literal: I repeatedly appealed to your sovereign, but Liaodong blocked reports from reaching him.
translations.idiomatic: I appealed again and again to your sovereign, yet Liaodong kept word from reaching the throne.

sentences.zh: 我兵至此，欲爾主察之也。

translations.literal: My army has come here so that your sovereign may investigate.
translations.idiomatic: My army has come so that your sovereign may look into the matter.

sentences.zh: 及攻撫順，又因十三省商賈各遺以書，慮其不克徑達，則各以書進其省官吏，冀有一聞。

translations.literal: When we attacked Fushun I also sent letters through merchants of the thirteen provinces, fearing they would not reach you directly, and therefore submitted each letter to that province's officials, hoping something might be heard.
translations.idiomatic: When we struck Fushun I also sent letters by merchants of the thirteen provinces; fearing they would not go straight to court, each letter was delivered to the officials of that province in hope that someone might hear.

sentences.zh: 乃縱之使去，寂焉不復。

translations.literal: Yet they were allowed to go and nothing more was heard.
translations.idiomatic: They were let go—and after that, silence.

sentences.zh: 語云：『下情上達，天下罔不治；

translations.literal: It is said: 'When the lower reaches the upper, none under Heaven is not governed;
translations.idiomatic: The proverb says: 'When what is below reaches what is above, all under Heaven is governed;

sentences.zh: 下情上壅，天下罔不亂。

translations.literal: when the lower is blocked from the upper, none under Heaven is not in turmoil.'
translations.idiomatic: 'when what is below is stopped from above, all under Heaven falls into disorder.'

sentences.zh: 』今所在征討，爭戰不息，民死鋒鏑，雖下情不達之故，抑豈天意乎？

translations.literal: Now campaigns rage everywhere and fighting does not cease; the people die by sword and spear—though this comes from blocked communication, is it not also Heaven's will?"
translations.idiomatic: "Today war rages on every side and the people die by the blade—partly because word does not rise, yet is this not also Heaven's decree?"

sentences.zh: 我今聞誠相告，國雖褊小，惟欲兩國和好，互為貿易，各安耕獵，以享太平。

translations.literal: I now speak to you in sincerity: though our state is small, we desire only peace between the two countries, mutual trade, each secure in farming and hunting, and the enjoyment of tranquillity.
translations.idiomatic: "I speak to you now in good faith: though our realm is small, we wish only peace between our states, trade in common, each at ease in field and hunt, and long tranquillity."

sentences.zh: 若言不由衷，天其鑒我。

translations.literal: If my words are not from the heart, may Heaven witness against me.
translations.idiomatic: "If these words are not sincere, may Heaven judge me."

sentences.zh: 前者屢致書問，憤疾之詞，固所不免。

translations.literal: In earlier letters anger and bitter words were inevitable.
translations.idiomatic: "In letters before this, harsh and angry words were unavoidable."

sentences.zh: 此兵家之常，不足道也。

translations.literal: This is the common way of warfare and not worth mentioning.
translations.idiomatic: "That is the common way of armies and need not be dwelt on."

sentences.zh: 幸速裁斷，實國之福。

translations.literal: I pray you decide quickly—truly the fortune of your state.
translations.idiomatic: "Decide quickly, for that is truly your state's blessing."

sentences.zh: 我駐兵十日以待。

translations.literal: I shall encamp ten days awaiting your reply."
translations.idiomatic: "I shall hold my camp ten days for your answer."

sentences.zh: 」庚辰，駐大同邊外。

translations.literal: " Gengchen day, encamped outside the Datong border.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day he encamped beyond the Datong frontier.

sentences.zh: 庫爾纏偕明得勝堡千總賚牲幣來獻。

translations.literal: Kuerchan came with a Ming thousand-commander from Desheng Fort bearing livestock and silks in tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Kuerchan arrived with a Ming thousand-commander from Desheng Fort bringing livestock and silks as gifts.

sentences.zh: 上不納。

translations.literal: The Emperor did not accept them.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor refused the gifts.

sentences.zh: 復遺書明守臣曰：「我仰體天意，原申和好。

translations.literal: Again sent a letter to the Ming garrison: "I respect Heaven's intent and wish only to renew peace.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote again to the Ming commander: "In accord with Heaven's will I seek only to restore peace.

sentences.zh: 爾果愛民，宜速定議。

translations.literal: If you truly care for the people, you should conclude terms at once.
translations.idiomatic: If you truly love the people, settle the matter at once.

sentences.zh: 若延時不報，縱欲相待，如軍中糧盡何。

translations.literal: If you delay and send no answer, even if you wish to wait on us, what is to be done when the army's grain is exhausted?"
translations.idiomatic: If you delay your reply, however much you may wish to wait, what can be done when the army's grain is gone?"

sentences.zh: 至書中稱謂，姑勿論，我遜爾國，我居察哈爾之上可耳。

translations.literal: As for forms of address in the letter, let that pass for now; I yield to your state—in ranking above Chakhar that suffices.
translations.idiomatic: As for how your letter addresses me, let that be for another day; I yield precedence to your court—only let me rank above Chakhar.

sentences.zh: 」癸未，趨宣府，守臣以明主所給察哈爾緞布皮幣一萬二千五百歸我。

translations.literal: " On the guiwei day, he hastened toward Xuanfu; the garrison commander returned to us twelve thousand five hundred pieces of satin, cloth, hides, and coin that the Ming ruler had given the Chakhar.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day he pressed toward Xuanfu. The garrison commander handed back twelve thousand five hundred pieces of satin, cloth, hides, and coin that the Ming emperor had granted the Chakhar.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，駐張家口外，列營四十里。

translations.literal: Gengyin day, encamped outside Zhangjiakou; camps were pitched for forty li.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day he encamped outside Zhangjiakou, his lines stretching forty li.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，明巡撫沈棨、總兵董繼舒遣人賚牛羊食物來獻。

translations.literal: Guisi day, Ming grand coordinator Shen Qi and regional commander Dong Jishu sent men bearing cattle, sheep, and provisions as gifts.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day Ming grand coordinator Shen Qi and regional commander Dong Jishu sent envoys with cattle, sheep, and food as tribute.

sentences.zh: 上宴之，遂定和議，大市於張家口。

translations.literal: The Emperor feasted them and thereupon settled a peace treaty; a great market was opened at Zhangjiakou.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor entertained them, peace was concluded, and a great market was opened at Zhangjiakou.

sentences.zh: 科爾沁部兵三人潛入明邊，盜牛驢，斬其首者，鞭二人，貫耳以徇。

translations.literal: Three soldiers of the Khorchin who had slipped into the Ming border and stolen cattle and donkeys: the ringleader was beheaded, two were flogged, and ears were bored through as a warning to the host.
translations.idiomatic: Three Khorchin soldiers who had crossed into Ming territory and stolen cattle and donkeys were punished: the leader was beheaded, two were flogged, and their ears were pierced and they were paraded before the army as a warning.

sentences.zh: 甲午，明巡撫沈棨遣使來請盟。

translations.literal: Jiawu day, Ming grand coordinator Shen Qi sent envoys to request alliance.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day Shen Qi, Ming grand coordinator, sent envoys to ask for a sworn alliance.

sentences.zh: 命大臣阿什達爾哈等蒞之，刑白馬烏牛，誓告天地。

translations.literal: He ordered ministers including Ashidarha to preside; a white horse and black ox were sacrificed and oath sworn before Heaven and Earth.
translations.idiomatic: He charged ministers led by Ashidarha to preside. A white horse and a black ox were offered in sacrifice and the oath was sworn before Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 禮成，遣啟心郎祁充格送明使歸。

translations.literal: When the rite was complete, he sent senior secretary Qi Chongge to escort the Ming envoys home.
translations.idiomatic: When the ceremony ended, senior secretary Qi Chongge was sent to conduct the Ming envoys back.

sentences.zh: 明以金幣來獻。

translations.literal: The Ming sent gold and coin as gifts.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming presented gold and coin in tribute.

sentences.zh: 晉封皇子豪格為和碩貝勒。

translations.literal: The prince Hooge was advanced to hošo-i beile rank.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Hooge was promoted to hošo-i beile.

sentences.zh: 是月，遼東大水。

translations.literal: That month, great floods struck eastern Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: That month eastern Liaodong suffered severe flooding.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁酉朔，復以書約明張家口守臣信誓敦好，善保始終，且謂和議遼東地方在內，爾須遣官往告。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, first day (dingyou cyclical), again wrote the Zhangjiakou garrison binding them by oath to lasting friendship and good faith to the end, and stating that Liaodong places were included in the peace—they must send officials to announce it.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the seventh month of autumn he wrote again to the Zhangjiakou commander, binding him by oath to lasting amity and urging him to keep faith to the end. He also declared that Liaodong was covered by the treaty and that Ming officials must be sent to proclaim it there.

sentences.zh: 上率大軍還。

translations.literal: The Emperor led the great army home.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor led the main army back.

sentences.zh: 庚子，至上都河，明以和議成，來餽禮物，酌納之。

translations.literal: Gengzi day, reached the Shangdu River; the Ming, the peace treaty being settled, sent gifts; he accepted them in measure.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day he reached the Shangdu River. With peace concluded, the Ming sent gifts, which he accepted in due measure.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，蒙古諸貝勒辭歸。

translations.literal: Xinchou day, the Mongol beile took leave and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day the Mongol beile departed for their own lands.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，次擺斯哈兒。

translations.literal: Gengxu day, halted at Baisiha'er.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day he encamped at Baisiha'er.

sentences.zh: 游擊巴克什達海卒。

translations.literal: Guerrilla officer Bakshi Dahai died.
translations.idiomatic: Guerrilla officer Bakshi Dahai died.

sentences.zh: 庚申，上還瀋陽。

translations.literal: Gengshen day, the Emperor returned to Shenyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day the Emperor returned to Shenyang.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯，召明諸生王文奎、孫應時、江雲入宮，問以和事成否。

translations.literal: Eighth month, dingmao day, summoned Ming scholars Wang Wenkuai, Sun Yingshi, and Jiang Yun into the palace and asked whether peace could hold.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the dingmao day, he summoned the Ming scholars Wang Wenkuai, Sun Yingshi, and Jiang Yun and asked whether the peace would endure.

sentences.zh: 三人皆言，明政日紊，和議難必。

translations.literal: All three said Ming government grew daily more chaotic and peace could hardly be assured.
translations.idiomatic: All three answered that Ming government was daily more disorderly and that a lasting peace was unlikely.

sentences.zh: 且中原盜賊蜂起，人民離亂。

translations.literal: Moreover bandits swarmed in the Central Plain and the people were scattered in disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits, they added, were rising everywhere in the Central Plain and the people were in turmoil.

sentences.zh: 勸上宣佈仁義，用賢養民，乘時吊伐，以應天心。
