translations.literal: They urged the Emperor to proclaim benevolence and righteousness, employ the worthy and nurture the people, take the moment to comfort the afflicted and punish the wicked, and answer Heaven's mind.
translations.idiomatic: They urged him to proclaim benevolence and righteousness, employ worthy men and care for the people, seize the moment to succor the suffering and chastise the guilty, and so answer Heaven's will.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，六部署成，頒銀印各一。

translations.literal: Guiyou day, the Six Ministries were completed; each was issued one silver seal.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day the Six Ministries were fully established, and each received a silver seal.

sentences.zh: 甲午，命固山額真察民疾苦，清理刑獄。

translations.literal: Jiawu day, ordered gushan ejen to investigate the people's hardships and clear up penal cases.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day he ordered the gushan ejen to inquire into the people's hardships and to review criminal cases.

sentences.zh: 察哈爾檮納楚虎爾來歸。

translations.literal: Chonochuhor of the Chakhar came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Chonochuhor of the Chakhar submitted.

sentences.zh: 九月癸卯，修覆蓋州城，移民實之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, guimao day, Fugaizhou city was repaired and people were moved in to fill it.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the guimao day, Fugaizhou was rebuilt and settlers were moved in to populate it.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，命戶部貝勒德格類、兵部貝勒岳託展耀州舊界至蓋州迤南。

translations.literal: Jiayin day, ordered Household Bureau beile Degelai and War Bureau beile Yueto to extend from the old Yaozhou boundary southward to Gaizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day he ordered Household Bureau beile Degelai and War Bureau beile Yueto to extend our frontier from the old Yaozhou line south to Gaizhou.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙丑朔，幸開原。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, first day (yichou cyclical), visited Kaiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the tenth month of winter he went to Kaiyuan.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，還瀋陽。

translations.literal: Jiaxu day, returned to Shenyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day he returned to Shenyang.

sentences.zh: 遣衛徵囊蘇喇嘛赴寧遠，賚書致明帝曰：「我國稱兵，非不知足而冀大位，因邊臣欺侮，致啟兵釁。

translations.literal: He sent Wei Zheng Nangsu Lama to Ningyuan with a letter to the Ming emperor: "Our state took up arms not from discontent or desire for the throne, but because frontier officials insulted us and opened hostilities.
translations.idiomatic: He dispatched Wei Zheng Nangsu Lama to Ningyuan with a letter to the Ming emperor: "Our state has taken up arms not from greed or ambition for the throne, but because your frontier officials insulted us and provoked war.

sentences.zh: 往征察哈爾時，過宣府定和議，我遂執越境盜竊之人戮之塞下，我之誠心可謂至矣。

translations.literal: When we marched against the Chakhar we passed Xuanfu and concluded peace; we then seized border-crossing thieves and executed them below the wall—our good faith has been complete.
translations.idiomatic: On our campaign against the Chakhar we passed Xuanfu and made peace. We then seized men who crossed the border to steal and executed them at the frontier. Our sincerity could not have been greater.

sentences.zh: 前邊臣未能細述，今欲備言，又恐疑我不忘舊怨，如遣信使來，將盡告之。

translations.literal: Former frontier officials did not set it forth in detail. Now I wish to explain fully, yet fear you will suspect I nurse old grievances. If you send envoys I will tell all.
translations.idiomatic: Your frontier officials never reported this fully. I would now explain everything, yet I fear you will think I still brood on old wrongs. Send envoys and I will lay out the whole matter.

sentences.zh: 若謂已和，不必語及往事，亦惟命。

translations.literal: If you say peace is made and the past need not be spoken of, I obey your will alone."
translations.idiomatic: If you hold that peace is enough and the past should not be raised, I bow to your wish."

sentences.zh: 」又與明諸臣書曰：「宣府守臣與我盟時，約我毋侵遼東，誓諸天地。

translations.literal: He also wrote Ming ministers: "When the Xuanfu garrison allied with us they bound us not to invade Liaodong, swearing before Heaven and Earth.
translations.idiomatic: He also wrote to Ming ministers: "When the Xuanfu commander allied with us he bound us not to invade Liaodong, with an oath sworn before Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 今爾乃有異議，天可欺乎？

translations.literal: Now you raise objections—can Heaven be deceived?
translations.idiomatic: Now you dispute the terms—can Heaven itself be deceived?

sentences.zh: 執政大臣宜通權變，慎勿徒事大言，坐失事機。

translations.literal: Governing ministers should act with flexible judgment; do not indulge in empty boasts and miss the moment.
translations.idiomatic: Those who govern should weigh circumstances and act; do not fill your dispatches with grand words and let the moment slip away.

sentences.zh: 若堅執不從，惟尋師旅，生靈荼毒，咎將誰歸？

translations.literal: If you stubbornly refuse and only seek armies, the people will suffer—on whom will the blame fall?"
translations.idiomatic: If you stand firm and will hear only of war, the common people will bear the suffering—who then will answer for it?"

sentences.zh: 十一月壬寅，明寧遠守臣以我所遺書封固，不敢以陳，請露封，許之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, renyin day, the Ming Ningyuan garrison said our letter was sealed and they dared not present it unopened; they asked to break the seal—permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day of the eleventh month the Ningyuan garrison reported that our letter arrived sealed and they dared not open it before the throne; they asked leave to break the seal, and it was granted.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，阿祿部都思噶爾濟農所屬祁他特吹虎爾台吉來附。

translations.literal: Xinhai day, Qitete Chuihu'er taiji of Dosiger Jiyin's Aru division came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day Qitete Chuihu'er taiji, subject of Dosiger Jiyin of the Aru, came to submit.

sentences.zh: 壬子，遣使往朝鮮定歲貢額。

translations.literal: Renzi day, envoys were sent to Korea to fix the annual tribute quota.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day envoys were sent to Korea to set the annual tribute quota.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙丑，定朝服及官民常服制。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, yichou day, fixed regulations for court dress and regular dress of officials and people.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the yichou day, regulations were fixed for court dress and the everyday dress of officials and commoners.

sentences.zh: 三貝勒莽古爾泰卒。

translations.literal: Third-rank beile Manggotai died.
translations.idiomatic: Third-rank beile Manggotai died.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，吳巴海征兀札喇遣使告捷。

translations.literal: Yihai day, envoys reported victory from Ubahai's campaign against Ujar.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day messengers arrived announcing Ubahai's victory over the Ujar.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月庚子，諭各牛錄額真以恤貧訓農習射。

translations.literal: Seventh year, spring, first month, gengzi day, instructed each niru ejen to succor the poor, teach farming, and practice archery.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the seventh year, on the gengzi day, he ordered every niru ejen to relieve the poor, instruct the people in farming, and drill in archery.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，朝鮮來貢，不及額。

translations.literal: Xinchou day, Korea sent tribute below the quota.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day Korea sent tribute that fell short of the fixed quota.

sentences.zh: 丁未，復書責之。

translations.literal: Dingwei day, wrote again reproaching them.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day he wrote again to rebuke them.

sentences.zh: 戊申，皇長女下嫁敖漢部貝勒都喇爾巴圖魯子台吉班第。

translations.literal: Wushen day, the eldest imperial daughter was married to taiji Bandi, son of Dorlar Baturu, beile of the Ao Han.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day the eldest imperial daughter was given in marriage to taiji Bandi, son of Ao Han beile Dorlar Baturu.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，征兀札喇師還。

translations.literal: Yimao day, the Ujar campaign army returned.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day the army returned from the campaign against the Ujar.

sentences.zh: 二月癸亥朔，阿魯科爾沁汗車根率固木巴圖魯、達爾馬代袞等舉國來附。

translations.literal: Second month, first day (guihai cyclical), Aru Khorchin Khan Chergen led Gumbaturu, Darmadaigun, and others bringing the whole nation to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the second month Aru Khorchin Khan Chergen came with Gumbaturu, Darmadaigun, and the rest, bringing the whole tribe to submit.

sentences.zh: 己卯，庫爾纏有罪，誅。

translations.literal: Jimao day, Kuerchan was guilty and executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day Kuerchan was found guilty and put to death.

sentences.zh: 癸未，土魯什、勞薩等略寧遠。

translations.literal: Guiwei day, Turusi, Laosa, and others raided Ningyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day Turusi, Laosa, and others raided Ningyuan.

sentences.zh: 三月丁酉，築鹻場、攬盤、通遠堡、岫巖四城。

translations.literal: Third month, dingyou day, built four forts—Yanchang, Lanpan, Tongyuanbao, and Xiuyan.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day of the third month four forts were built: Yanchang, Lanpan, Tongyuanbao, and Xiuyan.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，郭爾羅斯部台吉固木來朝。

translations.literal: Xinchou day, taiji Gum of the Gorlos came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day taiji Gum of the Gorlos came to court.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，明故總兵毛文龍部將孔有德、耿仲明遣使來約降。

translations.literal: Bingchen day, Ming former regional commander Mao Wenlong's subordinates Kong Youde and Geng Zhongming sent envoys to arrange defection.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day Kong Youde and Geng Zhongming, former subordinates of Ming commander Mao Wenlong, sent envoys to negotiate surrender.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙丑，察哈爾兩翼大總管塔什海虎魯克寨桑來附。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, yichou day, Chakhar left- and right-wing grand overseer Tashihai Horluk jaisang came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the yichou day, Tashihai Horluk jaisang, grand overseer of the Chakhar left and right wings, submitted.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，使參將英俄爾岱等借糧朝鮮濟孔有德軍，不從。

translations.literal: Yihai day, deputy generals including Enggurdai were sent to borrow grain from Korea to supply Kong Youde's army; they refused.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day Enggurdai and other deputy generals were sent to borrow grain from Korea for Kong Youde's troops; the Koreans refused.

sentences.zh: 五月乙未，吳喇忒台吉土門達爾漢等來朝。

translations.literal: Fifth month, yiwei day, Wurate taiji Tumendahan and others came to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the yiwei day, Wurate taiji Tumendahan and others came to court.

sentences.zh: 壬子，貝勒濟爾哈朗、阿濟格、杜度率兵迎孔有德、耿仲明於鎮江，命率所部駐東京。

translations.literal: Renzi day, beile Jirhalang, Ajige, and Dudu led troops to welcome Kong Youde and Geng Zhongming at Zhenjiang and ordered them to garrison Dongjing with their followers.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day beile Jirhalang, Ajige, and Dudu marched to Zhenjiang to receive Kong Youde and Geng Zhongming and ordered them to station their forces at Dongjing.

sentences.zh: 六月壬戌，諭將士毋侵擾遼東新附人民，違者孥戮之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, renxu day, ordered troops not to harass newly submitted Liaodong people; violators and their families were executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the renxu day, he forbade troops to molest the newly submitted people of Liaodong, on pain of death for the offender and his kin.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，召孔有德、耿仲明入覲，厚賚之。

translations.literal: Guihai day, Kong Youde and Geng Zhongming were summoned to audience and richly rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day Kong Youde and Geng Zhongming were received in audience and given rich rewards.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，遣英俄爾岱遺朝鮮王書曰：「往之借糧，貴國王以孔有德等昔隸毛氏，無輸糧養敵之理。

translations.literal: Bingyin day, Enggurdai was sent with a letter to the Korean king: "Your former refusal of grain rested on Kong Youde and others once serving Mao—there was no reason to feed our enemies.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day Enggurdai was dispatched with a letter to the king of Korea: "When you refused grain before, you said Kong Youde and his fellows had served Mao Wenlong and that you would not supply our enemies.

sentences.zh: 今有德歸我，糧已足給。

translations.literal: Now De has come to us and grain is ample.
translations.idiomatic: Now De has joined us and our grain is sufficient.

sentences.zh: 惟兵卒守船，輓運維艱，近距貴國，以糧給之甚便。

translations.literal: Only troops guarding the ships find transport hard; Korea is near—supplying grain would be very convenient.
translations.idiomatic: Only the troops guarding the ships still find transport difficult. Your country is close at hand; to furnish grain would be most convenient.

sentences.zh: 朕思王視明為父，視朕為兄，父兄相爭數年，而王坐觀成敗，是外有父兄之名，而內懷幸禍之意。

translations.literal: I think you treat the Ming as father and me as elder brother. Father and brother have fought for years while you sat watching—outwardly family, inwardly hoping for misfortune.
translations.idiomatic: I consider that you treat the Ming as a father and me as an elder brother. Father and brother have contended for years while you sat by and watched—which outwardly is kinship, but inwardly is the mind of one who hopes for another's ruin.

sentences.zh: 若力為解勸，息兵成好，不惟我兩國樂見太平，即貴國亦受其福。

translations.literal: If you strongly mediate and make peace, not only our two states will rejoice in peace—Korea too will share the blessing.
translations.idiomatic: If you exert yourself to mediate and restore peace, not only will our two states enjoy tranquility—your own kingdom will share the blessing.

sentences.zh: 若仍以兵助明，合而御我，則構兵實自王始。

translations.literal: If you still aid the Ming with arms and unite against me, you will be the one who began the war."
translations.idiomatic: If you still send troops to aid the Ming and join them against me, you will be the one who first brought on war."

sentences.zh: 」己巳，諭官民冠服遵制畫一。

translations.literal: Jisi day, ordered officials and people to unify caps and dress according to regulation.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day he commanded officials and commoners alike to conform their caps and dress to the new regulations.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以孔有德為都元帥，耿仲明為總兵官，並賜敕印。

translations.literal: Guiyou day, Kong Youde was made commander-in-chief and Geng Zhongming regional commander; each received edict and seal.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day Kong Youde was appointed commander-in-chief and Geng Zhongming regional commander; each was granted an edict and seal.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，英俄爾岱奏報朝鮮用明人計，借兵倭國，又於義州南嶺築城備我。

translations.literal: Wuyin day, Enggurdai reported Korea followed Ming advisers' plan, sought troops from Japan, and built a fort on Yizhou's southern ridge against us.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day Enggurdai reported that Korea, heeding Ming advisers, planned to borrow troops from Japan and was building a fort on the southern ridge of Yizhou against us.

sentences.zh: 集諸貝勒大臣議之，皆言宜置朝鮮而伐明。

translations.literal: The beile and ministers were convened; all said Korea should be set aside and the Ming attacked.
translations.idiomatic: The beile and ministers were assembled in council; all agreed that Korea should be left aside and the Ming attacked.

sentences.zh: 己卯，貝勒岳託、德格類率右翼楞額禮、葉臣，左翼伊爾登、昂阿喇及石廷柱、孔有德、耿仲明將兵取明旅順口。

translations.literal: Jimao day, beile Yueto and Degelai led right-wing Lenggeri and Yechen, left-wing Ilden and Angara, with Shi Tingzhu, Kong Youde, and Geng Zhongming to take Ming Lüshunkou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day beile Yueto and Degelai led the right-wing commanders Lenggeri and Yechen and the left-wing Ilden and Angara, together with Shi Tingzhu, Kong Youde, and Geng Zhongming, to seize Ming Lüshunkou.

sentences.zh: 甲申，東海使犬部額駙僧格來朝貢。

translations.literal: Jiashen day, Sangge, efu of the Donghai Inu division, came to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day Sangge, imperial son-in-law of the Donghai Inu division, came to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，諭曰：「凡進言者，如朕所行未協於義，宜直言勿諱。

translations.literal: Dinghai day, edict: "Those who advise: if my conduct fails in right, speak plainly without reserve.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day he proclaimed: "All who offer counsel: if my actions fall short of right, speak plainly and hold nothing back.

sentences.zh: 政事或有愆忌，宜開陳無隱。

translations.literal: If policy errs, lay it open without concealment.
translations.idiomatic: If affairs go wrong, set them forth without concealment.

sentences.zh: 六部諸臣，奸偽貪邪，行事不公，宜行糾劾。

translations.literal: Six Ministries officials who are deceitful, greedy, or unjust—expose them.
translations.idiomatic: Officials of the Six Ministries who are false, greedy, or partial in judgment—you are to impeach them.

sentences.zh: 諸臣有艱苦之情，亦據實奏聞。

translations.literal: Ministers in hardship should also report truthfully.
translations.idiomatic: If any minister suffers hardship, let him report it as it is.

sentences.zh: 苟不務直言，遠引曲喻，剿襲紛然，何益於事？

translations.literal: If you do not speak straight but quote distant examples and copy others in confusion, what use is that?
translations.idiomatic: If you will not speak directly but only cite remote precedents and repeat one another in a tangle of words, what good does that do?

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛卯朔，諭滿洲各戶有漢人十丁者授棉甲一，以舊漢軍額真馬光遠統之。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, first day (xinmao cyclical), every Manchu household with ten Han Chinese was given one cotton armor; old Han Army ejen Maguangyuan was to command them.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the seventh month of autumn, every Manchu household that held ten Han Chinese was issued one cotton corselet, to be commanded by Maguangyuan, ejen of the old Han Army.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，阿祿部孫杜稜子台吉古木思轄布，寨桑吳巴什、阿什圖、巴達爾和碩齊等，吳喇忒部台吉阿巴噶爾代皆來朝貢。

translations.literal: Renchen day, Gomusixabu taiji son of Sundu, jaisang Ubashi, Ashitu, Badar hosoi, and others of the Aru; Wurate taiji Abagarda—all came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day Gomusixabu taiji, son of Sundu of the Aru, with jaisang Ubashi, Ashitu, Badar hosoi, and others, and Wurate taiji Abagarda—all came to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，貝勒岳託等奏克旅順口。

translations.literal: Jiachen day, beile Yueto and others reported the capture of Lüshunkou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day beile Yueto and his colleagues reported that Lüshunkou had been taken.

sentences.zh: 八月庚申朔，英俄爾岱等自朝鮮還，以復書允糧濟我守船軍士。

translations.literal: Eighth month, first day (gengshen cyclical), Enggurdai returned from Korea with a reply agreeing to supply grain to our ship-guard troops.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eighth month Enggurdai returned from Korea with a reply consenting to furnish grain for our troops guarding the ships.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，貝勒阿巴泰、阿濟格、薩哈廉、豪格等略明山海關外。

translations.literal: Renxu day, beile Abatai, Ajige, Sahaliyan, Hooge, and others raided outside Ming Shanhaiguan.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day beile Abatai, Ajige, Sahaliyan, Hooge, and others raided beyond Ming Shanhaiguan.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，貝勒德格類、岳託師還。

translations.literal: Gengchen day, beile Degelai and Yueto's army returned.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day the army under beile Degelai and Yueto returned.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以副將石廷柱為總兵官。

translations.literal: Dinghai day, deputy commander Shi Tingzhu was made regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day deputy commander Shi Tingzhu was appointed regional commander.

sentences.zh: 九月庚子，貝勒阿巴泰等師還。

translations.literal: Ninth month, gengzi day, beile Abatai and others' army returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the gengzi day, the army under beile Abatai and the others returned.

sentences.zh: 上以其不深入，責之。

translations.literal: The Emperor reproached them for not penetrating deeply.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor rebuked them for failing to press deep into enemy country.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，英俄爾岱等往朝鮮互市。

translations.literal: Guimao day, Enggurdai and others went to Korea for mutual trade.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day Enggurdai and his party went to Korea to open mutual trade.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，明登州都司蔡賓等來降。

translations.literal: Gengxu day, Ming Dengzhou commander Cai Bin and others came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day Cai Bin of Ming Dengzhou and others defected.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬戌，遣使外籓蒙古各部，宣佈法令。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, renxu day, envoys sent to Mongol tribes of the outer fan to proclaim laws.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the renxu day, envoys were sent among the outer Mongol tribes to proclaim the laws.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，大閱。

translations.literal: Bingyin day, a great review was held.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day a grand military review was held.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，發帑賚八旗步兵。

translations.literal: Dingmao day, treasury funds were issued to reward the Eight Banners foot soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day funds from the treasury were distributed to reward the Eight Banners foot soldiers.

sentences.zh: 己巳，諭曰：「置官以來，吏、戶、兵三部辦事盡善，刑部訊獄稽延，罔得實情，禮部、工部皆有缺失。

translations.literal: Jisi day, edict: "Since offices were established, Personnel, Revenue, and War have handled affairs well; Justice delays trials and fails to get truth; Rites and Works both have lapses.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day he declared: "Since the ministries were set up, the boards of Personnel, Revenue, and War have managed their business well; Justice drags out trials and fails to learn the facts; Rites and Works both fall short.

sentences.zh: 夫啟心郎之設，欲其隨事規諫，啟乃心也。

translations.literal: Senior secretaries exist to advise on affairs and open their hearts.
translations.idiomatic: Senior secretaries were instituted precisely so they might counsel on each matter and open their hearts.

sentences.zh: 乃有差謬而不聞開導，何耶？

translations.literal: Yet errors go uncorrected—why no guidance?
translations.idiomatic: Yet when mistakes occur I hear no remonstrance—why?

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「爾等動以航海取山東攻山海關為言。

translations.literal: He also said: "You constantly speak of sailing to take Shandong and attacking Shanhaiguan.
translations.idiomatic: He added: "You are forever urging that we sail to seize Shandong and storm Shanhaiguan.

sentences.zh: 航海多險，攻堅易傷，是以空言相賺，不啻為敵計耳。

translations.literal: Sailing is perilous and assaulting strongholds costly—you offer empty talk no better than scheming for the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: The sea road is full of peril and storming strong places brings heavy loss. Such talk is empty boasting—no better than plotting for the enemy.

sentences.zh: 兵事無藉爾言，惟朕與諸貝勒有過，當極言耳。

translations.literal: Military matters need not your words—only if I and the beile err should you speak to the utmost."
translations.idiomatic: War needs none of your schemes; speak to the full only when I or the beile go wrong."

sentences.zh: 」又諭文館諸儒臣曰：「太祖始命巴克什額爾德尼造國書，後庫爾纏增之。

translations.literal: " He also instructed the Literary Office scholars, saying: "Taizu first ordered bakshi Erdeni to create the national script; later Kuerchan augmented it.
translations.idiomatic: He also addressed the scholars of the Literary Office: "Taizu first charged bakshi Erdeni with devising the national script, and Kuerchan later enlarged it.

sentences.zh: 慮有未合，爾等職司紀載，宜悉心訂正。

translations.literal: Fearing there might still be discrepancies, you whose office is to keep the records ought to revise it with full care.
translations.idiomatic: If anything remains amiss, you who keep the chronicle must correct it with all diligence.

sentences.zh: 朕嗣大位，凡皇考行政用兵之大，不一一詳載，後世子孫何由而知，豈朕所以盡孝道乎？

translations.literal: Since I succeeded to the great throne, if every major act of governance and war of my imperial father were not set down in full detail, how could later generations know them — and how would that be my fulfilling filial piety?"
translations.idiomatic: Having taken the great throne, were I not to record in full every weighty act of rule and war of my imperial father, how would later generations learn of them? How would I be discharging filial duty?"

sentences.zh: 」丙子，授明降將馬光遠為總兵官，王世選、麻登雲為三等總兵官，馬光先、孟喬芳等各授職有差。

translations.literal: " Bingzi day, Ming surrendered general Ma Guangyuan was appointed regional commander; Wang Shixuan and Ma Dengyun were made third-rank regional commanders; Ma Guangxian, Meng Qiaofang, and others were given offices in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day the Ming defector Ma Guangyuan was made regional commander; Wang Shixuan and Ma Dengyun were appointed third-rank regional commanders; Ma Guangxian, Meng Qiaofang, and others received posts according to merit.

sentences.zh: 癸未，明廣鹿島副將尚可喜遣使來約降。

translations.literal: Guiwei day, Ming vice-commander of Guanglu Island Shang Kexi sent envoys to negotiate surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day Shang Kexi, Ming vice-commander on Guanglu Island, sent envoys to arrange his submission.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲辰，英俄爾岱復賚書往朝鮮，責以違約十事。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, jiachen day, Ying'oerdai was again sent with a letter to Korea charging ten breaches of treaty.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day of the eleventh month Ying'oerdai was again dispatched to Korea with a letter listing ten violations of treaty.

sentences.zh: 戊申，遣季思哈、吳巴海往征朝鮮接壤之虎爾哈部。

translations.literal: Wushen day, Jisiha and Wubaihai were sent to campaign against the Hurka tribe on the Korean border.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day Jisiha and Wubaihai were sent against the Hurka along the Korean frontier.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，上獵於葉赫。

translations.literal: Xinhai day, the Emperor hunted in Yehe.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day the Emperor hunted in Yehe.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛未，上還瀋陽。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, xinwei day, the Emperor returned to Shenyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day of the twelfth month the Emperor returned to Shenyang.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月庚寅，諭蒙古諸貝勒令遵我國定制。

translations.literal: Eighth year, spring, first month, gengyin day, the Mongol beile were ordered to observe our state's institutions.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the eighth year, on the gengyin day, the Mongol beile were commanded to follow our laws and customs.

sentences.zh: 黑龍江羌圖裡、嘛爾干率六姓來朝貢。

translations.literal: Qiangtuli and Ma'ergan of the Heilongjiang led six clans to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Qiangtuli and Ma'ergan of the Heilongjiang brought six clans to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，詔宗人自興祖直皇帝出者為六祖後，免其徭役。

translations.literal: Guisi day, edict: kinsmen descended from the six ancestors from Emperor Xingzu Zhi onward were exempt from corvée.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day an edict declared that descendants of the six ancestors from Emperor Xingzu Zhi were freed from corvée.

sentences.zh: 乙未，正黃旗都統、一等總兵官楞額禮卒。

translations.literal: Yiwei day, Ledenge, banner commander of the Plain Yellow Banner and first-rank regional commander, died.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day Ledenge, commander of the Plain Yellow Banner and a first-rank regional commander, died.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，漢備御訴漢人徭役重於滿洲，戶部貝勒德格類以聞。

translations.literal: Guimao day, Han reserve officers complained that corvée burdens on Han Chinese exceeded those on Manchus; Household Bureau beile Degui reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day Han reserve officers protested that Han corvée was heavier than Manchu; Household Bureau beile Degui laid the matter before the throne.

sentences.zh: 上命禮部貝勒薩哈廉集眾諭其妄。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered Rites Bureau beile Sahalian to gather the crowd and declare the complaint groundless.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor had Rites Bureau beile Sahalian assemble the people and pronounce the charge false.

sentences.zh: 漢總兵官石廷柱等執備御八人請罪，上曰：「若加以罪，則後無復言者。

translations.literal: Han regional commanders Shi Tingzhu and others seized eight reserve officers and asked that they be punished; the Emperor said: "If they are punished, no one will speak hereafter.
translations.idiomatic: Han regional commander Shi Tingzhu and others arrested eight reserve officers and begged their punishment. The Emperor said, "Punish them, and none will dare speak again.

sentences.zh: 」並釋之。

translations.literal: " All were released.
translations.idiomatic: " All were set free.

sentences.zh: 戊申，塔布囊等征察哈爾潰眾於席爾哈、席伯圖。

translations.literal: Wushen day, Tabunang and others campaigned against routed Chakhar troops at Xierha and Xibotu.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day Tabunang and others struck routed Chakhar bands at Xierha and Xibotu.

sentences.zh: 己酉，蒿齊忒部台吉額林臣來歸。

translations.literal: Jiyou day, taiji Eilinchin of the Haqitai tribe came over.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day Eilinchin, taiji of the Haqitai, submitted.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，免功臣身故無嗣者丁之半，妻故始應役，著為令。

translations.literal: Dingsi day, for meritorious officials who died without heirs half the corvée was remitted; service began only after the wife's death — established as regulation.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day it was ordered that when a meritorious officer died without heirs, half the household corvée was waived and the remainder fell due only after his wife's death.

sentences.zh: 二月壬戌，定喪祭例，妻殉夫者聽，仍予旌表；

translations.literal: Second month, renxu day, regulations for mourning sacrifice were fixed: a wife who followed her husband in death was permitted and still given commendation;
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day of the second month rules for funeral rites were set: a wife who died with her husband was allowed and still honored;

sentences.zh: 逼妾殉者，妻坐死。

translations.literal: whoever forced a concubine to follow was sentenced to death for the wife.
translations.idiomatic: but anyone who compelled a concubine to die with him was punished with the wife's death.

sentences.zh: 遣貝勒多爾袞、薩哈廉往迎降將尚可喜，使駐海州。

translations.literal: Beile Dorgon and Sahalian were sent to welcome the surrendered general Shang Kexi and station him at Haizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Beile Dorgon and Sahalian were sent to receive the defector Shang Kexi and post him at Haizhou.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，都元帥孔有德劾耿仲明不法狀，諭解之。

translations.literal: Dingmao day, commander-in-chief Kong Youde impeached Geng Zhongming for unlawful conduct; they were ordered reconciled.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day commander-in-chief Kong Youde accused Geng Zhongming of misconduct; the Emperor ordered them to make peace.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，遣阿山等略錦州。

translations.literal: Wuchen day, Asan and others were sent to raid Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day Asan and others were dispatched to harry Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 三月丁亥朔，日有食之，綠虹見。

translations.literal: Third month, dinghai first day, there was a solar eclipse; a green rainbow appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the third month, dinghai, the sun was eclipsed and a green rainbow was seen.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，命譚泰、圖爾格略錦州。

translations.literal: Xinmao day, Tangtai and Turgai were ordered to raid Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day Tangtai and Turgai were sent against Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，副將尚可喜率三島官民降，駐海州。

translations.literal: Renchen day, vice-commander Shang Kexi led the officials and people of the three islands in surrender and was stationed at Haizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day Vice-commander Shang Kexi brought the three islands' officials and people in submission and was garrisoned at Haizhou.

sentences.zh: 己亥，大閱。

translations.literal: Jihai day, a grand review was held.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day the troops were reviewed in full.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，遣英俄爾岱往朝鮮互市。

translations.literal: Jiachen day, Ying'oerdai was sent to Korea for mutual trade.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day Ying'oerdai was sent to Korea to open border markets.

sentences.zh: 令孔有德、耿仲明、尚可喜幟用白鑲皁，以別八旗。

translations.literal: Kong Youde, Geng Zhongming, and Shang Kexi were ordered to use banners of white with black borders to distinguish them from the Eight Banners.
translations.idiomatic: Kong Youde, Geng Zhongming, and Shang Kexi were given standards of white edged in black to set them apart from the Eight Banners.

sentences.zh: 壬子，考試漢生員。

translations.literal: Renzi day, Han licentiates were examined.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day Han licentiates sat for examination.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛酉，升授太祖諸子湯古代等副將、參將、備御有差。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, xinyou day, Taizu's sons Tangdai and others were promoted to vice-commander, particolored commander, and reserve officer in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the xinyou day, Taizu's sons Tangdai and the rest were raised to vice-commander, particolored commander, and reserve officer according to rank.

sentences.zh: 又以哈達、烏喇二部之後無顯職，授哈達克什內為副將，烏喇巴彥為三等副將。

translations.literal: Because descendants of the Hada and Ula had no prominent posts, Hada Keshine was made vice-commander and Ula Bayan third-rank vice-commander.
translations.idiomatic: As heirs of Hada and Ula held no notable office, Hada Keshine was made vice-commander and Ula Bayan third-rank vice-commander.

sentences.zh: 詔以瀋陽為「天眷盛京」，赫圖阿喇城為「天眷興京」。

translations.literal: Edict: Shenyang was named "Shengjing favored by Heaven"; Hetu Ala city was named "Xingjing where Heaven's favor arose."
translations.idiomatic: An edict styled Shenyang "Shengjing, the capital Heaven favors" and Hetu Ala "Xingjing, where Heaven's favor first rose."

sentences.zh: 改定總兵、副將、參將、游擊、備御滿字官名。

translations.literal: The Manchu titles for regional commander, vice-commander, particolored commander, guerrilla officer, and reserve officer were revised.
translations.idiomatic: Manchu designations for regional commander, vice-commander, particolored commander, guerrilla officer, and reserve officer were reordered.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，尚可喜來朝，命為總兵官。

translations.literal: Dingchou day, Shang Kexi came to court and was appointed regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day Shang Kexi presented himself at court and was made regional commander.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以太祖弟之子拜尹圖為總管。

translations.literal: Yihai day, Bayintu, son of the Taizu's younger brother, was made commandant-general.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day Bayintu, son of the Taizu's younger brother, was appointed commandant-general.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，初命禮部考試滿洲、漢人通滿、漢、蒙古書義者，取剛林等十六人為舉人，賜衣一襲，免四丁。

translations.literal: Xinsi day, the Rites Ministry for the first time examined those versed in Manchu, Han, and Mongol script; Ganglin and fifteen others were chosen as juren, each given one suit of clothes and exemption for four ding.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day the Board of Rites first tested proficiency in Manchu, Han, and Mongol; Ganglin and fifteen others passed as juren, each receiving a suit of robes and exemption for four households.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，金繼孟等自明石城島來降，以隸尚可喜。

translations.literal: Yiyou day, Jin Jimeng and others came over from the Ming Shicheng Island and were placed under Shang Kexi.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day Jin Jimeng and others defected from Ming Shicheng Island and were assigned to Shang Kexi.

sentences.zh: 五月丙戌朔，黑龍江巴爾達齊來貢。

translations.literal: Fifth month, bingxu first day, Bardachi of the Heilongjiang came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fifth month, bingxu, Bardachi of the Heilongjiang presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，察哈爾台吉毛祁他特來朝。

translations.literal: Gengyin day, Chakhar taiji Moqitete came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day Chakhar taiji Moqitete came to court.

sentences.zh: 定滿、漢馬步軍名。

translations.literal: Names for Manchu and Han horse and foot were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Designations for Manchu and Han cavalry and infantry were standardized.

sentences.zh: 丙申，議征明，諸貝勒請從山海關入。

translations.literal: Bingshen day, an expedition against the Ming was debated; the beile asked to enter by Shanhaiguan.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day the court debated war on the Ming; the beile urged a thrust through Shanhaiguan.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「不然，察哈爾為我軍所敗，其貝勒大臣將歸我，宜直趨宣、大以逆之。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "That will not do. The Chakhar were beaten by our army; their beile and ministers will come to us. We should strike straight for Xuanfu and Datong to meet them."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "No. The Chakhar are broken; their princes and ministers will turn to us. March at once on Xuanfu and Datong to receive them."

sentences.zh: 」乃集各都統部署軍政，遣國舅阿什達爾哈徵科爾沁兵，以書招撫遺眾之在明境者。

translations.literal: Thereupon each banner commander deployed army affairs; imperial uncle Ashidahai was sent to levy Khorchin troops, and letters were sent to win over remnants still in Ming territory.
translations.idiomatic: Each banner commander then drew up the order of march; the imperial uncle Ashidahai was sent to raise Khorchin levies, and letters went out to draw in fugitives still within Ming borders.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，定百官功次，賜敕書，其世襲及官止本身者，分別開載有差。

translations.literal: Renyin day, officials' merits were ranked and patent letters granted; hereditary tenure and offices limited to the holder's own person were set forth separately.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day ranks of merit were fixed and patents issued, distinguishing hereditary posts from offices held only for the lifetime of the grantee.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，季思哈、吳巴海征虎爾哈部奏捷。

translations.literal: Jiachen day, Jisiha and Wubaihai reported victory over the Hurka.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day Jisiha and Wubaihai sent word of victory over the Hurka.

sentences.zh: 命貝勒濟爾哈朗留守盛京，貝勒杜度守海州，吏部承政圖爾格等渡遼河，沿張古台河駐防，並扼敵兵，俱授方略。

translations.literal: Beile Jirhalang was ordered to guard Shengjing; beile Dudu Haizhou; Board of Civil Appointments chengguan Turgai and others crossed the Liao and encamped along the Zhanggutai River to block the enemy — all were given detailed plans.
translations.idiomatic: Beile Jirhalang was left to hold Shengjing; beile Dudu, Haizhou; Turgai of the Board of Civil Appointments and others crossed the Liao and encamped on the Zhanggutai River to bar the Ming — each received his instructions.

sentences.zh: 畢，上率大軍前發。

translations.literal: When this was finished, the Emperor led the great army forward.
translations.idiomatic: When the dispositions were complete, the Emperor marched with the main host.

sentences.zh: 己酉，次都爾鼻，諸蒙古外籓兵以次來會。

translations.literal: Jiwei day, halted at Du'erbi; Mongol tributary troops came up in succession.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day he halted at Du'erbi while Mongol auxiliaries joined in turn.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，次訥裡特河。

translations.literal: Jiayin day, halted at the Nelite River.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day he encamped on the Nelite River.

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉，頒軍令於蒙古諸貝勒及孔有德、耿仲明、尚可喜，曰：「行軍時勿離纛，勿諠譁，勿私出劫掠。

translations.literal: Sixth month, xinyou day, army orders were issued to the Mongol beile and to Kong Youde, Geng Zhongming, and Shang Kexi, saying: "On the march do not leave the standards; do not raise an uproar; do not go out on private raids.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day of the sixth month military orders went to the Mongol beile and to Kong Youde, Geng Zhongming, and Shang Kexi: "Keep the standards; keep silence; do not plunder on your own.

sentences.zh: 抗拒者誅之，歸順者字之。

translations.literal: Whoever resists shall be put to death; whoever submits shall be spared.
translations.idiomatic: Slay those who resist; spare those who yield.

sentences.zh: 勿毀廟宇，勿殺行人，勿奪人衣服，勿離人夫婦，勿淫人婦女。

translations.literal: Do not destroy temples; do not kill travelers; do not seize people's clothes; do not separate husbands and wives; do not violate women's persons.
translations.idiomatic: Do not wreck shrines; do not kill wayfarers; do not strip travelers of clothing; do not part husband and wife; do not force women.

sentences.zh: 違者治罪。

translations.literal: Whoever violates this shall be punished."
translations.idiomatic: Whoever breaks these rules shall answer for it."

sentences.zh: 」先是，察哈爾林丹西奔圖白特，其部眾苦林丹暴虐，逗遛者什七八，食盡，殺人相食，屠劫不已，潰散四出。

translations.literal: " Earlier, Chakhar Lindan had fled west to Tubait; his tribesmen, suffering Lindan's cruelty, lingered in seven or eight out of ten; food was gone; they killed and ate one another; slaughter and plunder never ceased; they broke up and scattered in all directions.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Chakhar Lindan had fled west to Tubait. His people, worn down by his tyranny, hung back in great numbers; when provisions failed they turned on one another; killing and robbery never ceased, and the host broke apart in every direction.

sentences.zh: 至是，絡繹來附者前後數千戶。

translations.literal: By this time those who came in submission numbered several thousand households before and after.
translations.idiomatic: Now they came in waves, several thousand households in all.

sentences.zh: 辛未，次庫黑布裡都，議覺羅布爾吉、英俄爾岱擅殺察哈爾布顏圖部眾罪，並奪其賜。

translations.literal: Xinwei day, halted at Kuhuibidu; Jueluo Bu'erji and Ying'oerdai were judged for killing Chakhar of Buyantu tribe without authority, and their rewards were taken back.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day he halted at Kuhuibidu. Jueluo Bu'erji and Ying'oerdai were condemned for slaughtering Buyantu Chakhar without orders, and their gifts were revoked.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，次喀喇拖落木，命貝勒德格類率兵入獨石口，偵居庸關，期會師於朔州。

translations.literal: Jiaxu day, halted at Kala Tuoluomu; beile Degui was ordered to lead troops into Dushikou and scout Juyong Pass, with rendezvous at Shuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day he encamped at Kala Tuoluomu and sent beile Degui through Dushikou to reconnoiter Juyong Pass, to join the main body at Shuozhou.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，諭蒙古諸貝勒曰：「科爾沁噶爾珠塞特爾等叛往索倫，為其族兄弟等追獲被殺，朕心惻然。

translations.literal: Wuyin day, the Mongol beile were instructed: "Khorchin Galdzuserter and others rebelled and fled toward the Solon; their kinsmen pursued and killed them, and my heart was moved.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day he told the Mongol beile, "Galdzuserter of the Khorchin fled in revolt toward the Solon and was run down and slain by his own kin, and I was grieved.

sentences.zh: 朕欲宣佈德化，使人民共登安樂。

translations.literal: I wish to spread civilizing virtue and let the people together attain peace and joy.
translations.idiomatic: I mean to extend civilizing rule until all live in peace and contentment.

sentences.zh: 今諸貝勒雖以罪誅，亦朕教化所未洽也。

translations.literal: Though the beile now put them to death for crime, my teaching had not yet reached them."
translations.idiomatic: Even when you beile execute men for crime, it shows my teaching has not yet won them."

sentences.zh: 」又命減阿魯部達喇海等越界駐牧罪。

translations.literal: He also ordered the penalty reduced for Dalahai of the Aru tribe and others who pastured across the border.
translations.idiomatic: He also lightened the punishment of Dalahai of the Aru and others who had grazed beyond their bounds.

sentences.zh: 壬午，察哈爾土巴濟農率其民千戶來歸。

translations.literal: Renwu day, Chakhar Tubajinong led his thousand households in submission.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day Chakhar Tubajinong came in with a thousand households.

sentences.zh: 喀爾喀部巴噶達爾漢來歸。

translations.literal: Bagadarhan of the Khalkha came over.
translations.idiomatic: Bagadarhan of the Khalkha submitted.

sentences.zh: 甲申，命大貝勒代善等率兵入得勝堡，略大同，西至黃河，副都統土魯什、吳拜等逕歸化撫察哈爾逃民，俱會師朔州。

translations.literal: Jiashen day, great beile Daishan and others were ordered to lead troops into Desheng Fort, harry Datong as far as the Yellow River; vice-commanders Tulushi and Wu Bai went straight to Guihua to gather fleeing Chakhar people — all to rendezvous at Shuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day great beile Daishan was sent through Desheng Fort to raid Datong to the Yellow River; vice-commanders Tulushi and Wu Bai went to Guihua to round up Chakhar fugitives — all were to meet at Shuozhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己丑，命貝勒阿濟格、多爾袞、多鐸等入龍門，會宣府，上親統大軍自宣府趨朔州，期四路兵剋期並進。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, jichou day, beile Ajige, Dorgon, and Dodo were ordered to enter Longmen and join at Xuanfu; the Emperor personally led the great army from Xuanfu toward Shuozhou; the four armies were to advance together on the appointed day.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the jichou day, beile Ajige, Dorgon, and Dodo were sent through Longmen to unite at Xuanfu while the Emperor led the main host from Xuanfu on Shuozhou; the four columns were to march together on the set day.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，毀邊牆。

translations.literal: Xinmao day, the border wall was torn down.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day the frontier wall was broken through.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，入上方堡，至宣府右衛，以書責明守臣負盟之罪，仍諭其遣使議和。

translations.literal: Renchen day, entered Shangfang Fort and reached Xuanfu Right Guard; a letter blamed the Ming commanders for breaking treaty and still urged them to send envoys to treat for peace.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day he passed Shangfang Fort to Xuanfu Right Guard, sent a letter charging the Ming garrison with breach of alliance, and again invited envoys to negotiate peace.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，駐城東南。

translations.literal: Guisi day, encamped southeast of the city.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day he encamped southeast of the walls.

sentences.zh: 時阿濟格攻龍門，未下，令略保安。

translations.literal: At that time Ajige assaulted Longmen but had not taken it; he was ordered to raid Bao'an.
translations.idiomatic: Ajige was still pressing Longmen without success and was told to turn against Bao'an.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，營東城，遺明代王書，復約其遣使議和。

translations.literal: Dingyou day, encamped east of the city; a letter was sent to the Ming Prince of Dai, again asking that envoys be sent to discuss peace.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day he pitched camp east of the city and wrote the Ming Prince of Dai, once more urging that envoys come to parley.

sentences.zh: 代善攻得勝堡，克之。

translations.literal: Daishan attacked Desheng Fort and took it.
translations.idiomatic: Daishan stormed Desheng Fort and carried it.

sentences.zh: 明參將李全自縊死。

translations.literal: Ming particolored commander Li Quan hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: Ming particolored commander Li Quan took his own life.

sentences.zh: 進攻懷仁、井坪，皆不克，遂駐朔州。

translations.literal: He pressed the attack on Huairen and Jingping but could not take them, and encamped at Shuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: He assailed Huairen and Jingping without success and drew up at Shuozhou.

sentences.zh: 丙午，上圍應州，令代善等趣馬邑。

translations.literal: Bingwu day, the Emperor besieged Yingzhou and ordered Daishan and the rest to hurry to Mayi.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day the Emperor invested Yingzhou and sent Daishan and the others toward Mayi.

sentences.zh: 土魯什至歸化城，察哈爾林丹之妻率其八寨桑以一千二百戶來降。

translations.literal: Tulushi reached Guihua City; Lindan's wife led eight banners with twelve hundred households in surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Tulushi came to Guihua City, where Lindan's wife brought eight banners and twelve hundred households in submission.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，阿濟格等攻保安州，克之。

translations.literal: Gengxu day, Ajige and the others attacked Bao'an Prefecture and took it.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day Ajige and his column stormed Bao'an Prefecture and captured it.

sentences.zh: 壬子，德格類入獨石口，取長安嶺，攻赤城，不克，俱會師於應州。

translations.literal: Renzi day, Degui entered Dushikou, took Chang'an Ridge, and attacked Chicheng without success; all joined the main body at Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day Degui passed Dushikou, seized Chang'an Ridge, and assaulted Chicheng in vain; every column then united at Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月乙卯，命諸將略代州。

translations.literal: Eighth month, yimao day, the generals were ordered to raid Daizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the yimao day, the commanders were sent to harry Daizhou.

sentences.zh: 薩哈廉襲崞縣，拔之。

translations.literal: Sahalian surprised Zhuo County and took it.
translations.idiomatic: Sahalian stormed Zhuo County by surprise and carried it.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，碩托入圓平驛。

translations.literal: Bingchen day, Shutuo entered Yuanping post.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day Shutuo took Yuanping post.

sentences.zh: 甲子，阿巴泰等取靈丘縣之王家莊，克之。

translations.literal: Jiazi day, Abatai and others seized Wangjiazhuang in Lingqiu County and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day Abatai and others stormed Wangjiazhuang in Lingqiu and took it.

sentences.zh: 禮部承政巴都禮戰歿。

translations.literal: Board of Rites chengguan Baduli was killed in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Baduli, chengguan of the Board of Rites, fell in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 又攻應州之石家村堡，克之。

translations.literal: They also attacked Shijiacun fort of Yingzhou and took it.
translations.idiomatic: They next carried Shijiacun fort below Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，上發應州，聞明陽和總督張宗衡、大同總兵曹文詔駐懷仁，度是夜必奔大同，令土魯什、吳拜伏兵邀之。

translations.literal: Bingyin day, the Emperor left Yingzhou; hearing that Ming Yanghe governor Zhang Zongheng and Datong regional commander Cao Wenzhao were at Huairen, he judged they would flee to Datong that night and ordered Tulushi and Wu Bai to lie in ambush.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day the Emperor raised the siege of Yingzhou. Learning that Zhang Zongheng, Ming governor of Yanghe, and Cao Wenzhao, regional commander of Datong, were at Huairen, he expected them to bolt for Datong that night and set Tulushi and Wu Bai in wait.

sentences.zh: 師行遲，宗衡等逸去。

translations.literal: The troops marched slowly; Zongheng and the rest slipped away.
translations.idiomatic: The march was slow; Zongheng and his party escaped.

sentences.zh: 上怒責之。

translations.literal: The Emperor angrily rebuked them.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor rebuked them in anger.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，上至大同，遺書文詔，令贊和議。

translations.literal: Wuchen day, the Emperor reached Datong and sent a letter to Wenzhao urging him to support the peace talks.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day he came before Datong and wrote Cao Wenzhao to lend his weight to negotiation.

sentences.zh: 又遺書眾官，索察哈爾餘孽之在明者。

translations.literal: He also sent letters to the officials demanding those Chakhar remnants still with the Ming.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote the other commanders as well, demanding surrender of Chakhar fugitives still sheltered by the Ming.

sentences.zh: 文詔挑戰，擊敗之。

translations.literal: Wenzhao offered battle and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Wenzhao came out to fight and was beaten.

sentences.zh: 貝勒阿巴泰等拔靈丘。

translations.literal: Beile Abatai and others took Lingqiu.
translations.idiomatic: Beile Abatai and the rest captured Lingqiu.

sentences.zh: 明代王母楊氏與張宗衡、曹文詔以書來請和。

translations.literal: The Ming Prince's mother, Lady Yang, with Zhang Zongheng and Cao Wenzhao sent letters asking for peace.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Yang, mother of the Ming Prince of Dai, with Zhang Zongheng and Cao Wenzhao wrote to seek peace.

sentences.zh: 辛未，遣使以書報之。

translations.literal: Xinwei day, envoys were sent with letters in reply.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day he dispatched envoys with answering letters.

sentences.zh: 壬申，代善率師來會。

translations.literal: Renshen day, Daishan led his army to join.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day Daishan came up with his force.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，駐師大同，遣明宗室硃乃廷及俘獲僧人入城。

translations.literal: Guiyou day, the army encamped at Datong and sent the Ming clansman Zhu Naiting and a captured monk into the city.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day he encamped at Datong and sent the Ming royal Zhu Naiting and a monk taken prisoner into the city.

sentences.zh: 三索報書，俱不答。

translations.literal: Three times they asked for a reply; none came.
translations.idiomatic: Three times they demanded an answer; none was given.

sentences.zh: 縱乃廷妻子及硃乃振還。

translations.literal: Naiting's wife and children and Zhu Naizhen were released.
translations.idiomatic: He freed Naiting's wife and children and Zhu Naizhen.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，營四十里舖，得明間諜書北樓口，為書報之曰：「來書以滿洲為屬國，即予亦未嘗以為非也。

translations.literal: Dingchou day, encamped at the Forty-li Post; obtained a Ming spy's letter from Beiloukou and wrote back, saying: "Your letter treats Manchuria as a vassal state; I myself have never denied this either.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day he encamped at the Forty-li Post, took a Ming spy's letter from Beiloukou, and answered: "You call Manchuria a tributary land; I have never said otherwise myself.

sentences.zh: 惟遼東之官欺凌我國，皇帝惑於臣下之言狂，雖干戈十數年來，無一言詢及，使我國之情不達，若遣一信使判白是非，則兵戈早息矣。

translations.literal: Only the officials of Liaodong bully our state; the Emperor is misled by his ministers' reckless words; though arms have been raised for more than ten years, not one inquiry has been made, so that our state's case does not reach you—if you would send one envoy to judge right and wrong, the weapons would long since have ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Only the Liaodong officials oppress us, and Your Majesty is led astray by reckless counsel. For more than ten years of war not a single question has been put to us, so our grievance never reaches the throne. Send one envoy to settle who is right and wrong, and the fighting would already have ended.

sentences.zh: 欲享太平，只旦暮間事。

translations.literal: To enjoy great peace is only a matter between dawn and dusk.
translations.idiomatic: A lasting peace is only a daybreak away.

sentences.zh: 不然，爾國臣僚壅蔽欺罔，虛報斬伐，以吾小國果受傷夷，詎能數侵，豈皇帝之聰明獨不能一忖度耶？

translations.literal: Otherwise, your state's ministers block and deceive, falsely reporting slain enemies, thinking that our small state has truly suffered harm—how could we invade again and again? Can the Emperor's wisdom alone not weigh this once?
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise your ministers screen and deceive you, inventing body counts as though our little realm were truly broken—yet how could we raid you year after year? Surely Your Majesty's own mind can judge that once.

sentences.zh: 原和之誠，黑雲龍自知之，慮其恐結怨於大臣不盡告耳。

translations.literal: The original sincerity for peace Hei Yunlong knows in his own heart; I fear only that, lest he earn the hatred of the great ministers, he does not tell you everything.
translations.idiomatic: Hei Yunlong knows in his heart how sincere we were for peace; I fear only that, not wishing to offend your senior ministers, he has not told you the whole truth.

sentences.zh: 」己卯，大軍至陽和。

translations.literal: " On the jimao cyclical day the great army reached Yanghe.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day the main force reached Yanghe.

sentences.zh: 明總兵曹文詔詭以書言狂張宗衡，偽言砲傷我兵，得纛一桿等語，為我邏者所獲。

translations.literal: Ming regional commander Cao Wenchao craftily wrote a letter speaking wildly of Zhang Zongheng, falsely saying cannon had wounded our troops and that one banner staff had been taken—our scouts captured it.
translations.idiomatic: Ming commander Cao Wenchao forged a letter slandering Zhang Zongheng, claiming our men had been shattered by cannon and that a banner staff had been captured; our scouts seized the document.

sentences.zh: 上乃遺宗衡書曰：「予謂爾明當有忠臣義士實心謀國者，乃一旦虛言狂至此，豈不愧於心乎？

translations.literal: The Emperor thereupon sent Zongheng a letter saying: "I thought your Ming surely had loyal ministers and righteous men who sincerely planned for the state—suddenly reckless words to this extent; are you not ashamed in your heart?
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor then wrote to Zongheng: "I believed the Ming still had ministers who truly cared for the realm—yet suddenly such wild boasts reach this pitch. Have you no shame?"

sentences.zh: 今與公等約，我兵以一當十，能約期出戰，當勒兵以俟。

translations.literal: Now I make this pact with you all: our troops are one against ten; if you can agree on a day to give battle, I shall array my soldiers and wait.
translations.idiomatic: I now offer you this wager: one of my men against ten of yours. Name a day to fight, and I shall hold my ranks ready."

sentences.zh: 若言狂言欺君，貽害生靈，禍薛將無窮矣。

translations.literal: If reckless words deceive the sovereign and bring harm on the living, disaster will know no end."
translations.idiomatic: If reckless lies deceive your sovereign and ruin the people, the calamity will never end."

sentences.zh: 」壬午，次懷遠。

translations.literal: " On the renwu cyclical day he halted at Huaiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day he encamped at Huaiyuan.

sentences.zh: 癸未，駐左衛。

translations.literal: On the guiwei cyclical day he halted at Zuoyi.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day he halted at Zuoyi.

sentences.zh: 閏八月丙戌，以書責明宣府太監欺君誤國罪。

translations.literal: Intercalary eighth month, bingxu day: sent a letter reproaching the Xuanfu eunuch for the crime of deceiving the sovereign and ruining the state.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day of the intercalary eighth month he sent a letter charging the Xuanfu eunuch with deceiving the throne and betraying the realm.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，副都統土魯什被創卒。

translations.literal: Dinghai day: Vice Banner Commander Turusi died of wounds.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day Vice Banner Commander Turusi died of his wounds.

sentences.zh: 攻萬全左衛，克之。

translations.literal: Attacked Wanquan Left Guard and took it.
translations.idiomatic: He assaulted Wanquan Left Guard and captured it.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，班師。

translations.literal: Gengyin day: the army withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day the army marched home.

sentences.zh: 察哈爾噶爾馬濟農等遣使乞降，言其汗林丹病殂，汗子及國人皆欲來歸，於是命阿什達爾哈等往偵之。

translations.literal: Chakhar Garmejin and others sent envoys begging to surrender, saying their khan Lindan had died of illness and that the khan's son and the whole people wished to come over; the Emperor then ordered Ashidahha and others to reconnoiter.
translations.idiomatic: Chakhar leaders including Garmejin sent envoys to submit, reporting that Khan Lindan had died of illness and that his son and people wished to defect. The Emperor dispatched Ashidahha and others to verify the report.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，移軍舊上都城。

translations.literal: Dingyou day: moved the army to the old Shangdu city.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day the host shifted camp to the old city of Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，移軍克蚌。

translations.literal: Gengxu day: moved the army to Kebang.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day the army moved to Kebang.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，察哈爾寨桑噶爾馬濟農等率其國人六千奉豆土門福金來歸。

translations.literal: Xinhai day: Chakhar Saichan Garmejin and others led six thousand of their people, presenting the Doumen state seal, to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day Saichan Garmejin of the Chakhar and others brought six thousand followers and the Doumen imperial seal to surrender.

sentences.zh: 九月戊辰，留守貝勒濟爾哈朗疏報季思哈、吳巴海征虎爾哈俘一千三百餘人。

translations.literal: Ninth month, wuchen day: the prince left in garrison, Jirhalang, memorialized that Jisiha and Wubahai, campaigning against the Jurchen, had taken more than thirteen hundred captives.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day of the ninth month Prince Jirhalang, left to guard the capital, reported that Jisiha and Wubahai had campaigned against the Jurchen and brought back more than thirteen hundred prisoners.

sentences.zh: 阿魯部毛明安舉國來附。

translations.literal: The Aru tribe Maoming'an came over with the entire nation.
translations.idiomatic: The Aru chieftain Maoming'an led his whole people in submission.

sentences.zh: 辛未，渡遼河。

translations.literal: Xinwei day: crossed the Liao River.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day the army crossed the Liao River.

sentences.zh: 壬申，上還盛京。

translations.literal: Renshen day: the Emperor returned to Shenyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day the Emperor returned to Shenyang.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己丑，建太祖陵寢殿，樹松，立石獸。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, jichou day: built the hall at Taizu's mausoleum, planted pines, and set up stone beasts.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the jichou day, he built the hall at Taizu's tomb, planted pines, and erected stone guardian beasts.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，論征宣、大將士功罪。

translations.literal: Renchen day: deliberated the merits and crimes of the generals who had campaigned in Xuanfu and Datong.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day he judged the rewards and punishments of the commanders who had raided Xuanfu and Datong.

sentences.zh: 己亥，科爾沁台吉吳克善來歸其妹，納之。

translations.literal: Jihai day: Khorchin taiji Wukesan came to return his younger sister; she was taken in marriage.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day the Khorchin taiji Wukesan brought his younger sister for marriage, and the Emperor took her as consort.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以八年征討克捷，為文告太祖。

translations.literal: Gengxu day: because eight years of campaigns had achieved victory, a document of report was composed to Taizu.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, with eight years of campaigns crowned by success, he drafted a memorial report to Taizu.

sentences.zh: 壬子，朝鮮國王李倧遣使以書來。

translations.literal: Renzi day: the King of Korea, Li Jong, sent an envoy with a letter.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day King Li Jong of Korea sent an envoy bearing a letter.

sentences.zh: 上以其言不遜，復書切責之。

translations.literal: The Emperor, because the wording was disrespectful, wrote back in sharp rebuke.
translations.idiomatic: Finding the tone insolent, the Emperor answered with a stern rebuke.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙丑，六部官考績升授有差。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, yichou day: officials of the Six Boards were promoted or advanced in rank according to their performance reviews.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day of the eleventh month the Six Boards' officials received graded promotions after their performance reviews.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸未朔，朝鮮國王以書來謝罪。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, first day of the month (guiwei cyclical): the King of Korea sent a letter apologizing.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the twelfth month, a guiwei day, the King of Korea sent a letter of apology.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，命副都統霸奇蘭、參領薩木什喀征黑龍江未服之地。

translations.literal: Renchen day: ordered Vice Banner Commander Baqilan and Company Commander Samuska to campaign against still-unsubdued lands on the Amur.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day he ordered Vice Banner Commander Baqilan and Company Commander Samuska to subdue the Amur regions not yet brought in.

sentences.zh: 丙申，分定宗室、額駙等專管佐領有差。

translations.literal: Bingshen day: princes, imperial sons-in-law, and others were assigned in division to take exclusive charge of niru.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day princes and imperial sons-in-law were allotted separate command of the niru.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，墨勒根喇嘛以嘛哈噶喇金像來貢，遣使迎至盛京。

translations.literal: Dingyou day: the Mergen lama presented a golden image of Mahakala as tribute; envoys were sent to escort it to Shenyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day the Mergen lama offered a gilt image of Mahakala; the court sent envoys to bring it to Shenyang.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，察哈爾祁他特車爾貝、塞冷布都馬爾等各率所部人民來歸。

translations.literal: Guimao day: Chakhar Qitete Cherbei, Selingbudumaer, and others each led their followers to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day the Chakhar leaders Qitete Cherbei, Selingbudumaer, and others each came over with their people.

sentences.zh: 遣吳巴海、荊古爾代征瓦爾喀。

translations.literal: Wubahai and Jinggu'erdai were dispatched to campaign against the Valha.
translations.idiomatic: Wubahai and Jinggu'erdai were sent to campaign against the Valha.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，佐領劉學誠疏請立郊壇，勤視朝。

translations.literal: Jiachen day: niru leader Liu Xuecheng memorialized requesting the establishment of a suburban altar and diligent attendance at court.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day niru leader Liu Xuecheng memorialized asking that a suburban altar be built and that the sovereign hold court diligently.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「疏中欲朕視朝勤政是也。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "In the memorial, the wish that I attend court diligently in government is right.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "Your plea that I hold court diligently is well taken.

sentences.zh: 至建立郊壇，未知天意所在，何敢遽行，果成大業，彼時議之未晚也。

translations.literal: As for establishing a suburban altar, I do not know where Heaven's intent lies—how dare I act rashly? If the great enterprise is truly achieved, it will not be too late to discuss it then."
translations.idiomatic: But to raise a suburban altar—I do not yet know Heaven's will, and dare not act hastily. When the great undertaking is truly won, there will be time enough to decide."

sentences.zh: 九年春正月丁卯，上親送科爾沁土謝圖濟農等歸國。

translations.literal: Ninth year, spring, first month, dingmao day: the Emperor personally escorted the Khorchin Tuxetu jin and others back to their country.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the ninth year, on the dingmao day, the Emperor himself escorted the Khorchin Tuxetu jin and his party home.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，免功臣徭役。

translations.literal: Guiyou day: meritorious officials were exempted from corvée labor.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day meritorious officials were freed from corvée duties.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔太祖庶子稱「阿格」，六祖子孫稱「覺羅」，覺羅繫紅帶以別之。

translations.literal: Dingchou day: edict—Taizu's sons by concubines are to be called "Age"; descendants of the six founding ancestors are to be called "Gioro," and the Gioro are to wear a red belt to distinguish them.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day an edict declared that Taizu's sons by secondary wives should be styled Age, that descendants of the six ancestral lines should be styled Gioro, and that Gioro clansmen should wear a red belt as their mark.

sentences.zh: 有詈其祖父者罪至死。

translations.literal: Whoever curses another's grandfather is guilty to the death penalty.
translations.idiomatic: Whoever curses another man's grandfather shall be punished with death.

sentences.zh: 二月壬午，令諸臣薦舉居心公正及通曉文藝可任使者。

translations.literal: Second month, renyin day: ordered the various ministers to recommend men upright in heart and skilled in letters who could serve as envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day of the second month he ordered his ministers to recommend men of upright character and literary skill fit for diplomatic service.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，編喀喇沁部蒙古壯丁為十一旗，每旗設都統一員，下以副都統、參領二員統之。

translations.literal: Dinghai day: the able-bodied men of the Kharachin Mongols were organized into eleven banners; each banner was given one commander, under whom a vice commander and a company commander directed affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day the Kharachin Mongols were registered as eleven banners, each with a commander assisted by a vice commander and a company commander.

sentences.zh: 戊子，諭曰：「邇來進言者皆請伐明，朕豈不以為念。

translations.literal: Wuzi day, edict: "Of late those who memorialize all urge attacking the Ming; I indeed do not forget that aim.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day he proclaimed: "Lately every memorial urges war on the Ming, and I have not forgotten that goal.

sentences.zh: 然亦須相機而行。

translations.literal: Yet one must act according to opportunity.
translations.idiomatic: Yet we must wait for the right moment.

sentences.zh: 今察哈爾新附，人心未輯，城郭未修，而輕於出師，何以成大業？

translations.literal: Now the Chakhar have newly submitted and hearts are not yet settled; walls and towns are not yet repaired—if we lightly take the field, how shall we achieve the great enterprise?
translations.idiomatic: The Chakhar have only just submitted; hearts are not yet united and our defenses are unfinished. If we march rashly, how can the great enterprise succeed?

sentences.zh: 且大兵一舉，明主或棄而走，或懼而請和，攻拒之策，何者為宜？

translations.literal: Moreover, once the great army moves, the Ming ruler may flee or, in fear, sue for peace—which policy, attack or resistance, is fitting?
translations.idiomatic: And once our main force moves, the Ming sovereign may flee or sue for peace in terror—which course—pressing the attack or holding back—is the wiser?

sentences.zh: 其令高鴻中、鮑承先、寧完我、范文程等酌議以聞。

translations.literal: Let Gao Hongzhong, Bao Chengxian, Ning Wanwo, Fan Wencheng, and others weigh this and report."
translations.idiomatic: Let Gao Hongzhong, Bao Chengxian, Ning Wanwo, Fan Wencheng, and the rest deliberate and advise me."

sentences.zh: 」己丑，沈佩瑞請屯田廣寧、閭陽，造舟輓粟，為進取計。

translations.literal: " Jichou day: Shen Peirui requested garrison farming at Guangning and Lüyang, building boats to transport grain as a plan for advance.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day Shen Peirui proposed garrison colonies at Guangning and Lüyang and grain barges on the rivers as the logistics for a forward campaign.

sentences.zh: 上嘉納之。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised and accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor approved the plan with praise.

sentences.zh: 乙未，范文程、寧完我請薦舉不實宜行連坐法。

translations.literal: Yiwei day: Fan Wencheng and Ning Wanwo requested that false recommendations be punished by joint liability.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day Fan Wencheng and Ning Wanwo asked that officials who recommended unworthy men be punished together with their nominees.

sentences.zh: 丁未，命多爾袞、岳託、豪格、薩哈廉將精騎一萬，收察哈爾林丹之子額爾克孔果爾額哲。

translations.literal: Dingwei day: ordered Dorgon, Yueto, Hooge, and Sahalian to lead ten thousand picked cavalry to bring in Lindan's son Erkekuoguolezhe.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day he ordered Dorgon, Yueto, Hooge, and Sahalian to lead ten thousand elite horsemen to take Lindan's son Erkekuoguolezhe.

sentences.zh: 三月戊辰，諭曰：「頃民耕耨愆期，蓋由佐領有事築城，民苦煩役所致。

translations.literal: Third month, wuchen day, edict: "Recently the people have been late in plowing and hoeing—this is because niru leaders were busy building walls and the people suffered from oppressive labor.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day of the third month he proclaimed: "Farmers have fallen behind in the spring sowing because niru leaders pressed them into wall-building and abused their labor.

sentences.zh: 嗣有濫役妨農者治其罪。

translations.literal: Henceforth whoever abuses labor and obstructs farming shall be punished for his crime."
translations.idiomatic: From now on, whoever misuses corvée and hinders the harvest shall be punished."

sentences.zh: 」庚午，察哈爾寨桑巴賴都爾等一千四百餘人來歸。

translations.literal: " Gengwu day: Chakhar Saichan Baiduer and more than fourteen hundred others came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day Saichan Baiduer of the Chakhar and more than fourteen hundred followers submitted.

sentences.zh: 五月乙卯，霸奇蘭、薩木什喀征黑龍江虎爾哈部，盡克其地，編所獲人口以歸，論功升賞有差。

translations.literal: Fifth month, yimao day: Baqilan and Samuska campaigned against the Jurchen of Heilongjiang, wholly conquered their lands, organized the captives they took, and returned; rewards and promotions were graded by merit.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day of the fifth month Baqilan and Samuska subdued the Jurchen of the Amur country, settled the captives, and returned; rewards were apportioned by merit.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，上以西征諸貝勒經宣、大境，度明必調寧、錦兵往援，遣貝勒多鐸率師入寧、錦撓之。

translations.literal: Guihai day: the Emperor, because the beile on the western expedition would pass the Xuanfu and Datong frontier and estimated that the Ming would surely shift Ning and Jin troops to their aid, sent beile Dodo with an army into Ning and Jin to harass them.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, expecting the western beile to cross the Xuan–Da border and draw Ning–Jin relief troops, the Emperor sent beile Dodo to raid Ning and Jin and tie down the Ming reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 己巳，命文館譯宋、遼、金、元四史。

translations.literal: Jisi day: ordered the Literary Academy to translate the histories of the Song, Liao, Jin, and Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day he ordered the Literary Academy to translate the histories of the Song, Liao, Jin, and Yuan.

sentences.zh: 壬申，貝勒多鐸奏報殲明兵五百人於錦州松山城外，殺其副將劉應選。

translations.literal: Renshen day: beile Dodo memorialized that five hundred Ming troops had been destroyed outside Songshan of Jinzhou and that their vice commander Liu Yingxuan had been killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day beile Dodo reported that he had annihilated five hundred Ming soldiers outside Jinzhou's Songshan and killed Vice Commander Liu Yingxuan.

sentences.zh: 丙子，貝勒多爾袞、岳託、薩哈廉、豪格等奏報兵至西喇硃爾格，遇察哈爾囊囊太妃暨台吉瑣諾木等以一千五百戶降，遂抵額爾克孔果爾額哲所居，其母率額哲迎降。

translations.literal: Bingzi day: beile Dorgon, Yueto, Sahalian, Hooge, and others memorialized that the army had reached Xilazhuger, where Chakhar Nangnang taiji and taiji Suonuomu and others with fifteen hundred households surrendered; they then reached Erkekuoguolezhe's residence, and his mother led Erkezhe out to welcome them in surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day beile Dorgon, Yueto, Sahalian, Hooge, and the rest reported reaching Xilazhuger, where Nangnang taiji of the Chakhar and Suonuomu taiji surrendered with fifteen hundred households; they then came to Erkekuoguolezhe's seat, where his mother brought Erkezhe out to submit.

sentences.zh: 六月乙酉，貝勒多鐸凱旋，賜良馬五，賞從征將士有差。

translations.literal: Sixth month, yiyou day: beile Dodo returned in triumph; five fine horses were granted, and the generals who had accompanied the expedition were rewarded in varying measure.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day of the sixth month beile Dodo returned in triumph; he was given five fine horses and the campaign commanders were rewarded according to rank.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，吳巴海、荊古爾代師還，論功亦如之。

translations.literal: Dingyou day: the armies of Wubahai and Jinggu'erdai also returned, and rewards were likewise graded by merit.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day Wubahai and Jinggu'erdai came back as well, and their men were rewarded on the same principle.

sentences.zh: 明登州黃城島千總李進功來降。

translations.literal: Ming thousand-commander Li Jingong of Huangcheng Island, Dengzhou, came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jingong, Ming thousand-commander on Huangcheng Island off Dengzhou, defected to the Jin.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，諭曰：「太祖以人民付朕，當愛養之。

translations.literal: Xinchou day, edict: "Taizu entrusted the people to me; I ought to cherish and nurture them.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day he proclaimed: "Taizu entrusted the people to me, and I must cherish them.

sentences.zh: 諸貝勒非時修繕，勞苦百姓，民不得所，浸以逃亡，是違先志而長敵寇也。

translations.literal: The beile repair fortifications out of season, toiling the common people; the people have no security and gradually flee—this violates the former will and only strengthens the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the beile press wall-building out of season, wear out the common folk, and drive them to flight—betraying our founder's intent and feeding the enemy.

sentences.zh: 今朝鮮賓服，察哈爾舉國來附，苟不能撫輯其眾，後雖拓地，何以處之？

translations.literal: Now Korea has come to court and the whole Chakhar nation has submitted; if we cannot soothe and gather the masses, later, though we expand territory, how shall we settle them?
translations.idiomatic: Korea now pays court and all the Chakhar have submitted; if we cannot win their hearts, what good is wider territory when we cannot govern those within it?

sentences.zh: 貝勒大臣其各戢驕縱以副朕意！

translations.literal: Beile and great ministers, each curb your arrogance and license to match my intent!"
translations.idiomatic: Beile and ministers, curb your pride and excess and stand with my purpose!"

sentences.zh: 」壬寅，察哈爾台吉瑣諾木率其屬六千八百人來歸。

translations.literal: " Renyin day: Chakhar taiji Suonuomu led six thousand eight hundred dependents to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day Suonuomu taiji of the Chakhar brought six thousand eight hundred followers in submission.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，諭曰：「太祖禁貝勒子弟郊外放鷹，慮其踐田園、擾牲畜也。

translations.literal: Guimao day, edict: "Taizu forbade beile sons and younger brothers to fly hawks outside the suburbs, fearing they would trample fields and disturb livestock.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day he proclaimed: "Taizu forbade princes' sons to hawk outside the suburbs lest they trample the fields and harass the herds.

sentences.zh: 今違者日眾。

translations.literal: Now violators grow daily in number.
translations.idiomatic: Violations grow daily.

sentences.zh: 語曰：『涓涓不塞，將成江河。

translations.literal: The proverb says: 'A trickle left unstopped will become a river.
translations.idiomatic: As the proverb says, 'A trickle unchecked becomes a river.'

sentences.zh: 』其嚴禁之。

translations.literal: ' Strictly forbid it."
translations.idiomatic: Forbid it strictly."

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸酉，論漢人丁戶增減，擢參領李思忠等六員官，高鴻中等十一員黜罰有差。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, guiyou day: deliberated the increase and decrease of Han household registers; six company commanders including Li Sizhong were promoted to office, and eleven including Gao Hongzhong were dismissed or punished in varying measure.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day of the seventh month he reviewed Han household registers; six company commanders including Li Sizhong were promoted, while eleven officials including Gao Hongzhong were demoted or punished in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 八月庚辰，貝勒多爾袞、岳託、薩哈廉、豪格以獲傳國玉璽聞。

translations.literal: Eighth month, gengchen day: beile Dorgon and others reported the capture of the dynastic jade seal.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day of the eighth month beile Dorgon and the others announced that they had taken the imperial jade seal.

sentences.zh: 先是元順帝北狩，以璽從，後失之。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Emperor Shundi of the Yuan went north on campaign he took the seal with him; it was later lost.
translations.idiomatic: Long before, when the Yuan's Emperor Shundi withdrew northward he carried the seal away, and it was afterward lost.

sentences.zh: 越二百餘年，為牧羊者所獲。

translations.literal: After more than two hundred years it was obtained by a shepherd.
translations.idiomatic: More than two centuries later a shepherd found it.

sentences.zh: 後歸於察哈爾林丹汗。

translations.literal: Later it passed to Chakhar Khan Lindan.
translations.idiomatic: It later came into the hands of Chakhar Khan Lindan.

sentences.zh: 林丹亦元裔也。

translations.literal: Lindan was also a descendant of the Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: Lindan too was of Yuan imperial descent.

sentences.zh: 璽在蘇泰太妃所。

translations.literal: The seal was in the keeping of Lady Sutai.
translations.idiomatic: The seal was kept by Lady Sutai.

sentences.zh: 至是獻之。

translations.literal: At this time it was presented.
translations.idiomatic: Now it was presented to the throne.

sentences.zh: 時岳託以疾留歸化城，多爾袞等率兵略明山西，自平虜衛入邊，毀長城，略忻州、代州，至崞縣。

translations.literal: At that time Yueto, being ill, remained at Guihua City; Dorgon and others led troops to raid Ming Shanxi, entering the border by Pinglu Guard, destroying the Great Wall, and raiding Xinzhou, Daizhou, and as far as Guo County.
translations.idiomatic: Yueto, ill, stayed at Guihua City while Dorgon and the rest raided Shanxi, entering by Pinglu Guard, breaking the Great Wall, and sweeping Xinzhou, Daizhou, and Guo County.

sentences.zh: 甲申，繪太祖實錄圖成。

translations.literal: Jiashen day: the painted Veritable Record illustrations of Taizu were completed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day the illustrated Veritable Record of Taizu was finished.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，上率大貝勒代善及諸貝勒多爾袞等師次平虜堡。

translations.literal: Yisi day: the Emperor led senior beile Daishan and beile Dorgon and others; the army halted at Pinglu Fort.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day the Emperor marched with senior beile Daishan and beile Dorgon and others to encamp at Pinglu Fort.

sentences.zh: 丁未，渡遼河，閱巨流河城堡。

translations.literal: Dingwei day: crossed the Liao River and inspected Juliuhe castle.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day he crossed the Liao River and inspected the works at Juliuhe.

sentences.zh: 九月癸丑，貝勒多爾袞等師還，獻玉璽，告天受之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, guichou day: beile Dorgon and others returned; they presented the jade seal and announced to Heaven that it was received.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day of the ninth month beile Dorgon and the rest came back, presented the jade seal, and proclaimed its reception before Heaven.

sentences.zh: 額爾克孔果爾額哲及其母來朝。

translations.literal: Erkekuoguolezhe and his mother came to court.
