translations.idiomatic: Erkekuoguolezhe and his mother presented themselves at court.

sentences.zh: 庚午，上還宮。

translations.literal: Gengwu day: the Emperor returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day the Emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 壬申，召諸貝勒大臣數代善罪。

translations.literal: Renshen day: summoned the beile and great ministers to enumerate Daishan's crimes.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day he summoned the beile and senior ministers to list Daishan's offenses.

sentences.zh: 眾議削大貝勒號及和碩貝勒，奪十佐領，其子薩哈廉奪二佐領，哈達公主降庶人，褫其夫瑣諾木濟農爵號。

translations.literal: The assembly deliberated stripping the title of great beile and hošo beile, seizing ten niru, seizing two niru from his son Sahalian, degrading the Hada princess to commoner status, and stripping her husband Suonuomu of his jin rank.
translations.idiomatic: The council proposed removing Daishan's titles of great beile and hošo beile, confiscating ten of his niru and two from his son Sahalian, reducing the Hada princess to commoner rank, and stripping her husband Suonuomu of his jin title.

sentences.zh: 上皆免之。

translations.literal: The Emperor pardoned them all.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor pardoned them all.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己卯，以明議和不成，將進兵，遣使賚書諭明喜峰口、董家口諸邊將。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, jimao day: because Ming peace talks had failed and he was about to advance the army, envoys were sent bearing letters instructing the Ming border generals at Xifengkou and Dongjiakou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the jimao day, peace talks with the Ming having collapsed, he prepared to march and sent envoys with letters to the generals at Xifengkou and Dongjiakou.

sentences.zh: 管戶部事和碩貝勒德格類卒。

translations.literal: Degui, hošo beile in charge of the Board of Revenue, died.
translations.idiomatic: Degui, the hošo beile who headed the Board of Revenue, died.

sentences.zh: 癸未，命吳巴海、多濟裡、札福尼、吳什塔分將四路兵征瓦爾喀。

translations.literal: Guiwei day: ordered Wubahai, Duojeri, Zhafoni, and Wuxita each to command one of four columns to campaign against the Valha.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day he ordered Wubahai, Duojeri, Zhafoni, and Wuxita each to lead a column against the Valha.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁未朔，命額爾克孔果爾額哲奉母居孫島習爾哈。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, first day of the month (dingwei cyclical): ordered Erkekuoguolezhe to attend his mother in residence at Sundao Xierha.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eleventh month, a dingwei day, he assigned Erkekuoguolezhe to live with his mother at Sundao Xierha.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛巳，哈達公主莽古濟之僕冷僧機首告貝勒莽古爾泰生時與女弟莽古濟、弟德格類謀逆，公主之夫瑣諾木及屯布祿、愛巴禮與其事。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, xinsi day: Lengsenji, a servant of the Hada princess Mangguji, reported first that beile Mangguertai from birth, with his younger sister Mangguji and younger brother Degui, had plotted treason, and that the princess's husband Suonuomu together with Tunbulu and Aibali were in the affair.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day of the twelfth month Lengsenji, a servant of the Hada princess Mangguji, denounced beile Mangguertai for plotting treason from childhood with his sister Mangguji and his brother Degui, naming the princess's husband Suonuomu and Tunbulu and Aibali as accomplices.

sentences.zh: 會瑣諾木亦自首。

translations.literal: Suonuomu also surrendered himself.
translations.idiomatic: Suonuomu confessed as well.

sentences.zh: 訊得實，莽古濟、莽古爾泰子額必倫及屯布祿、愛巴禮皆伏誅。

translations.literal: Interrogation established the facts; Mangguji, Mangguertai's son Ebilun, and Tunbulu and Aibali were all executed.
translations.idiomatic: Examination proved the charge; Mangguji, Mangguertai's son Ebilun, Tunbulu, and Aibali were all put to death.

sentences.zh: 莽古爾泰餘子、德格類子俱為庶人。

translations.literal: Mangguertai's remaining sons and Degui's sons were all made commoners.
translations.idiomatic: Mangguertai's surviving sons and Degui's sons were reduced to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 瑣諾木自首免罪。

translations.literal: Suonuomu, because he surrendered himself, was exempted from punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Suonuomu was spared because he had turned himself in.

sentences.zh: 授冷僧機三等副將。

translations.literal: Lengsenji was appointed a third-rank vice commander.
translations.idiomatic: Lengsenji was made a third-rank vice commander.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，謁太祖陵。

translations.literal: Dingyou day: visited Taizu's tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day the Emperor visited Taizu's tomb.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，貝勒薩哈廉與諸貝勒及大貝勒代善盟誓，請上尊號。

translations.literal: Jiachen day: beile Sahalian, with the beile and senior beile Daishan, swore alliance and requested that the Emperor accept an honorific title.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day beile Sahalian joined the other beile and senior beile Daishan in a covenant asking the Emperor to take an imperial title.

sentences.zh: 上不許。

translations.literal: The Emperor did not consent.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 會蒙古貝勒復來請。

translations.literal: Mongol beile again came to request it.
translations.idiomatic: Mongol beile came again with the same plea.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「朝鮮兄弟國，宜告之。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Korea is a brother state; they should be informed."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "Korea is a brother kingdom; they ought to be told."

sentences.zh: 十年春正月壬戌，皇次女下嫁額爾克孔果爾額哲。

translations.literal: Tenth year, spring, first month, renxu day: the Emperor's second daughter was married to Erkekuoguolezhe.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the tenth year, on the renxu day, the Emperor's second daughter was given in marriage to Erkekuoguolezhe.

sentences.zh: 二月丁丑，八和碩貝勒與外籓四十九貝勒各遺書朝鮮，約其國王勸進尊號。

translations.literal: Second month, dingchou day: the eight hošo beile and forty-nine beile of the outer domains each sent letters to Korea, inviting that king to urge the honorific title.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day of the second month the eight hošo beile and forty-nine outer-domain beile each wrote to Korea asking its king to join in urging the imperial title.

sentences.zh: 戊子，遣使至明邊松棚路、潘家口、董家口、喜峰口、賚書致明帝，索其報書。

translations.literal: Wuzi day: sent envoys to the Ming border at Songpeng Road, Panjiakou, Dongjiakou, and Xifengkou, presenting a letter to the Ming Emperor and demanding a reply.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day envoys were sent to the Ming posts at Songpeng Road, Panjiakou, Dongjiakou, and Xifengkou with a letter to the Ming emperor demanding an answer.

sentences.zh: 定諸臣帽頂飾。

translations.literal: Fixed the hat-peak ornaments of the officials.
translations.idiomatic: Regulations were set for officials' hat insignia.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，寧完我以罪免。

translations.literal: Gengyin day: Ning Wanwo was dismissed for crime.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day Ning Wanwo was removed from office for misconduct.

sentences.zh: 三月丙午朔，清明節，謁太祖陵。

translations.literal: Third month, first day of the month (bingwu cyclical), Qingming Festival: visited Taizu's tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the third month, a bingwu day and the Qingming festival, he visited Taizu's tomb.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，改文館為內國史、內祕書、內弘文三院。

translations.literal: Xinhai day: changed the Literary Academy into the Inner Court of National History, Inner Secretariat, and Inner Court of Promoting Culture—three courts.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day the Literary Academy was divided into three inner courts: National History, Secretariat, and Promoting Culture.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，遣貝勒阿濟格、阿巴泰築噶海城。

translations.literal: Yimao day: sent beile Ajige and Abatai to build Gahai City.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day beile Ajige and Abatai were sent to build Gahai City.

sentences.zh: 庚申，吳什塔等征瓦爾喀，遣使奏捷。

translations.literal: Gengshen day: Wuxita and others, campaigning against the Valha, sent envoys reporting victory.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day Wuxita and the Valha expedition sent messengers announcing victory.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「蒙古深信喇嘛，實乃妄人。

translations.literal: Edict: "The Mongols deeply believe in lamas; they are truly deluded people.
translations.idiomatic: He proclaimed: "The Mongols put blind faith in lamas and are led astray.

sentences.zh: 嗣後有懸轉輪結布幡者，宜禁止之。

translations.literal: Henceforth whoever hangs prayer wheels or ties cloth prayer banners should be forbidden."
translations.idiomatic: Hereafter anyone who sets up prayer wheels or fluttering prayer banners is forbidden to do so."

sentences.zh: 」乙丑，英俄爾岱等自朝鮮還，言國王李倧不接見，亦不納書，以其報書及所獲倧諭邊臣書進。

translations.literal: " Yichou day: Ying'erdai and others returned from Korea, saying that King Li Jong would not receive them in audience and would not accept their letter; they presented his reply and the letter they had obtained from Jong instructing his border officials.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day Ying'erdai and his party returned from Korea reporting that King Li Jong would neither grant an audience nor accept their letter; they submitted Jong's reply and a captured letter in which he ordered his frontier officials.

sentences.zh: 諸貝勒怒，欲加兵。

translations.literal: The beile were angry and wished to send troops.
translations.idiomatic: The beile were furious and urged war.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「姑遣人諭以利害，質其子弟，不從，興兵未晚也。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "For the present send someone to explain advantage and harm and hold their princes as hostages; if they do not comply, raising troops will not be too late."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "For now send an envoy to lay out the stakes and take their princes as hostages. If they still refuse, it will be time enough to march."

sentences.zh: 」丁卯，外籓蒙古十六國四十九貝勒及孔有德、耿仲明、尚可喜俱以請上尊號至盛京。

translations.literal: " Dingmao day: Mongol beile of sixteen outer states and forty-nine beile, together with Kong Youde, Geng Zhongming, and Shang Kexi, all came to Shenyang requesting the honorific title.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day forty-nine beile from sixteen Mongol domains, together with Kong Youde, Geng Zhongming, and Shang Kexi, arrived at Shenyang to urge the imperial title.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己卯，大貝勒代善，和碩貝勒濟爾哈朗、多爾袞、多鐸、岳託、豪格、阿巴泰、阿濟格、杜度率滿、漢、蒙古大臣及蒙古十六國四十九貝勒以三體表文詣闕請上尊號曰：「恭維我皇上承天眷祐，應運而興。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, jimao day: senior beile Daishan, hošo beile Jirhalang, Dorgon, Dodo, Yueto, Hooge, Abatai, Ajige, and Dudu, with Manchu, Han, and Mongol grand ministers and the forty-nine beile of sixteen Mongol states, presented at court a memorial in three scripts requesting an honorific title, saying: "Respectfully considering that our Emperor receives Heaven's favor and, responding to the mandate, has risen.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day of the fourth month senior beile Daishan, hošo beile Jirhalang, Dorgon, Dodo, Yueto, Hooge, Abatai, Ajige, and Dudu, with Manchu, Han, and Mongol ministers and forty-nine beile from sixteen Mongol domains, submitted a trilingual memorial at court asking that he take the throne, declaring: "We respectfully observe that our sovereign enjoys Heaven's grace and has risen to answer the mandate.

sentences.zh: 當天下昏亂，修德體天，逆者威，順者撫，寬溫之譽，施及萬姓。

translations.literal: When all under Heaven was in disorder he cultivated virtue and embodied Heaven; those who resisted were awed, those who complied were comforted, and the reputation of kindness and gentleness reached the myriad households.
translations.idiomatic: When the realm was in chaos he cultivated virtue and matched Heaven's way: the defiant were overawed, the willing were soothed, and his fame for mercy spread to every household.

sentences.zh: 征服朝鮮，混一蒙古。

translations.literal: He conquered Korea and unified Mongolia.
translations.idiomatic: He conquered Korea and united Mongolia.

sentences.zh: 遂獲玉璽，受命之符，昭然可見，上揆天意，下協輿情。

translations.literal: He then obtained the jade seal—the token of receiving the mandate—clearly visible; above it accords with Heaven's intent, below it unites popular sentiment.
translations.idiomatic: He has now received the jade seal—the clear sign of Heaven's mandate—so that intent above and the people's will below are as one.

sentences.zh: 臣等謹上尊號，儀物俱備，伏原俞允。

translations.literal: We ministers respectfully present the honorific title; ritual objects are all prepared; we humbly pray Your Majesty to grant approval."
translations.idiomatic: We therefore beg to invest you with the imperial title; the ritual regalia is ready, and we humbly pray you will consent."

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「爾貝勒大臣勸上尊號，歷二年所。

translations.literal: " The Emperor said: "You beile and great ministers have urged the honorific title for two years.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "You beile and ministers have pressed this title upon me for two years.

sentences.zh: 今再三固請，朕重違爾諸臣意，弗獲辭。

translations.literal: Now, repeatedly and firmly requesting, I heavily violate your various ministers' intent and cannot decline.
translations.idiomatic: Now, with your repeated and earnest plea, I can no longer refuse without wronging you.

sentences.zh: 朕既受命，國政恐有未逮，爾等宜恪恭贊襄。

translations.literal: I having received the mandate, I fear state affairs may not yet reach perfection; you ought respectfully to assist and support."
translations.idiomatic: Having accepted the mandate, I fear the government may still fall short; you must serve me faithfully and well."

sentences.zh: 」群臣頓首謝。

translations.literal: " The ministers kowtowed in thanks.
translations.idiomatic: The ministers kowtowed in gratitude.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，禮部進儀注。

translations.literal: Gengchen day: the Board of Rites presented the ritual protocol.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day the Board of Rites submitted the coronation rites.

sentences.zh: 壬午，齋戒，設壇德盛門外。

translations.literal: Renwu day: fasted and set up the altar outside Desheng Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day he fasted and raised the altar outside Desheng Gate.
